clan_chain_title: Chain right after the end of the current season, with the same duration
clan_auto_renew_desc: When the end date has passed, the Bot automatically closes the season (rewards, HQ renaming, announcement) then immediately reschedules the next season for the same duration. A 3-month season therefore renews itself every quarter, without any intervention.
clan_auto_renew_active: Automatic renewal active (same duration carried over at each end of season).

clan_da_disabled_desc: Enable the Daily Algo module to convert its points into clan points. Clans work perfectly well without it.

clan_reset_all_desc: This button completely resets all clan-related data. All configured clans, the associated Discord roles (in the database), and the entire XP history of all seasons will be permanently erased.

clan_rollback_desc1: This button cancels the last season closure. If you are currently in Season {current}, you will return to Season {prev}.
clan_rollback_desc2: All XP contributions recorded for the active season (Season {current}) will be deleted. The winner of the previous season (Season {prevprev}) as well as its associated clan leaders will be restored.
clan_modal_desc: Link a Discord role and configure your clan's details.
clan_desc_placeholder: The clan's description, history, or motto...
clan_confirm_desc_clear: You are about to remove their clan from every member of the server. Each clan role is recreated identically - channel permissions included - then the old one is deleted, which strips it from everyone at once. The role ID changes: any outside setting pointing at it will need updating.
clan_confirm_desc_reset: You are about to close the active clan season and move to the next one. Clan XP scores will reset to 0. Every ongoing bet will be closed and its stake returned to the bettors: no bet can span the end of a season.
clan_confirm_desc_distribute: You are about to randomly assign a clan to every member without one. This action runs progressively in the background.
clan_confirm_desc_resetall: You are about to reset all clan data (permanent deletion of every configured clan, of all season contributions, and a return to season 1). Clan-point bets and debts are deleted too: nobody will owe anything any more, and staked points will not be returned. This action is completely irreversible.
clan_confirm_desc_rollback: You are about to undo the last season closure. You will return to season {prev}. Contributions from the active season (Season {current}) will be deleted, and the season {prevprev} winner along with its clan leaders will be restored. Bets played since the closure are deleted, their stakes returned, and clan-point debts go back to what they were at the end of season {prev}.
clan_rebalance_btn_title: Move members of the largest clans into the new clans
clan_rebalance_desc: Members of the most crowded clans join the clans to fill, in the order set by the chosen criterion. Activity is measured as previous-season points per day of presence, so members who joined mid-season are not penalised. Nothing changes before the final confirmation.
clan_rebalance_targets_hint: Unchecked clans give members. Clan leaders and members in an ongoing bet are never moved.
clan_rebalance_size_label: Target size per clan to fill
clan_rebalance_size_hint: Empty: the average of all clans.
clan_rebalance_protect_hint: A member above this threshold stays in their clan. The threshold applies to the points used to judge them: previous-season points, or current-season points for a member who joined too late for the previous one.
clan_rebalance_mode_least_hint: Spares the giving clans: they keep their regular players.
clan_rebalance_mode_random_hint: Random draw among movable members, regardless of activity.
clan_rebalance_mode_most_hint: Gives the new clans a strong team right away.
clan_rebalance_mode_most_warning: The giving clans lose their best players, the ones most attached to their clan. Consider the protection threshold to keep the pillars.
clan_rebalance_reference_random: Random draw: the activity shown is for information only and does not set the order. A new draw gives another list.
clan_rebalance_reference_previous: Members are judged on their season {season} points, relative to their days of presence. Those who joined too late for that season are judged on the current one.
clan_rebalance_reference_current: No previous season: members are judged on the current season, relative to their days of presence.
clan_rebalance_no_moves: No transfer possible with these settings: clans are already balanced, or every member of the giving clans is protected.

cm_tv_chat_open_hint: Anyone who can see the channel can write in it. Does not open voice access.
cm_tv_chat_locked_hint: Only the owner and the auto-allowed roles can write in it.

cm_tv_owner_powers_hint: What the channel creator receives on their own channel. These rights apply nowhere else on the server.
cm_tv_power_mute_hint: Mute a member present in their channel.
cm_tv_power_deafen_hint: Deafen a member present in their channel.

cm_tv_panel_desc: How the management panel is sent and displayed to members.
cm_tv_panel_components_v2: V2 — Components V2 (what the bot sends today)
cm_tv_panel_components_hint: V1: classic embed, fields in columns. V2: Components V2 (containers), what the bot sends today.
cm_tv_panel_components_v1_limit_channels: V1 only applies to the channels created afterwards: Discord never takes the Components V2 flag off a message that already carries it, so the panels already posted stay as they are.
cm_tv_panel_components_v1_limit_ephemera: Only the public panel switches to V1. The ephemeral sub-panels it opens stay in Components V2.
cm_tv_panel_mode_classic_hint: Three sections (Channel, Members, Ownership); each opens one more ephemeral message, but leaves room to search for anyone on the server, even someone not in the voice channel.
cm_tv_panel_mode_flat_hint: Everything on one screen, nothing to open. In exchange the screen itself only targets the people currently in voice: no row is left for a server-wide search. Transferring ownership still opens one.
cm_tv_panel_state_layout_grid3_hint: Two rows of three. The original layout, the one an embed uses for its fields.
cm_tv_panel_state_layout_grid2_hint: Three rows of two, wider: more room on mobile.
cm_tv_panel_state_layout_table_hint: One row per value, separated by a rule. The most readable with long values.
cm_tv_panel_state_layout_cards_hint: Each value in its own box, background at 70%. The only one readable in both light and dark.
cm_tv_panel_state_layout_native_hint: Discord lays the six values out itself — Status, Slots, Chat, Allowed, Banned, Reserved — as embed fields, with no image. Two cases do that: the 3-column grid in Components V1, and the 3-column grid kept on the Neutral colors.

cm_tv_panel_state_colors_neutral_hint: A mid grey, readable on a light theme as well as a dark one. The only one that suits everybody.
cm_tv_panel_state_colors_dark_hint: Light text. Crisp on the dark theme, unreadable on the light one.
cm_tv_panel_state_colors_light_hint: Black text. Crisp on the light theme, unreadable on the dark one.
cm_tv_panel_state_colors_hint: An image does not follow the theme of whoever looks at it: this single choice holds for the whole server, whatever theme each member runs. It only applies to the layouts the bot draws as an image, not to the 3-column grid in V1.

am_ghostping_desc: Detects pings that are deleted or edited quickly.
am_discord_native_desc: These filters use Discord's native AutoMod API. They are applied by Discord itself, before the bot even receives the message, for instant and reliable moderation.
am_customwords_desc: Automatically blocks messages containing forbidden words or phrases. Handled natively by Discord.
am_customwords_wildcard_hint: Use * as a wildcard: *spam* will match "antispam", "spammer", etc.
am_profanity_desc: Uses Discord's predefined word lists to automatically block insults, sexual content and hateful terms.

am_antibot_owner_only: Only the server owner can enable, disable or configure anti-bot secure mode.

am_antibot_bypass_desc: These users can add bots but cannot change this configuration.

am_antibot_notice: The Kotbo bot is never affected by this protection. Whoever added the bot receives a DM explaining the block.

am_adminlock_desc_after: permission. Internal actions require approval. External changes are automatically detected and reverted.

iv_attribution_hint: Give the same name to several links to group them. “TikTok”, “Instagram”, a campaign or a partner: anything goes.
iv_name_first_link: Name a first link to get started.
iv_reuse_name_hint: Reuse exactly the same name to group several invites together.
iv_assign_hint: Assign your links below to make the ranking appear.
iv_to_assign: invite to assign to complete your statistics.
iv_suspend_inviter_desc: Blocks new invites and can purge in cascade.
iv_untracked_one: {count} invite to assign to complete your statistics.
iv_untracked_other: {count} invites to assign to complete your statistics.
rp_desc: Define specific access for each Discord role.
rp_empty_state: No specific restriction. The module uses default permissions.
iv_channel_growth_question: Which channel is really growing the server?
ms_page_desc: Global search across all messages logged by the bot
ms_logging_enabled: Logging enabled - retroactive indexing starting in the background.
ms_ignored_channels_help: Nothing from these channels is recorded: no new messages, no edits, no deletions.
ms_indexing_desc: The bot is currently fetching old server messages (up to {days} days of retention). Results will update progressively.
ms_indexing_error: An error occurred: {error}. New messages will still continue to be logged.
ms_collect_started_desc: Only messages sent from now on are logged - previous history is not available. Results will appear as server activity occurs, check back later.
ms_logging_recent_notice: Logging is recent: few messages are recorded yet. The database will fill up with server activity.
ms_empty_disabled: Message logging is disabled. Enable it to start recording messages.
ms_empty_just_started: Collection has just started: messages sent from now on will appear here as activity occurs.
ts_page_desc: View, search, and delete channel transcripts
ev_page_desc: Create and manage interactive events on your Discord server (Quiz, CTF…).
ev_select_type_desc: Select the nature of your event. You can configure it in detail next.
ev_quiz_desc: Multiple choice or open answer questions. Ideal for testing your community's knowledge.
ev_ctf_desc: Cybersecurity challenges with hidden flags. Real-time leaderboard, reward roles.
ev_custom_desc: Discord event creation, premium announcement broadcast, and autonomous registration form.
ev_delete_confirm_desc: This action cannot be undone: all associated questions, responses, and participants will be deleted.
cf_page_desc: Create autonomous forms for your events or surveys. Linkable to recruitment if desired.
cf_no_form_desc: Create your first custom autonomous form to get started.
cf_auth_required: Discord login required for this form
cf_hierarchy_hint: Determines the role/grade assigned automatically upon hire from this form.
da_plan_to_start: Schedule a challenge to get started.
da_no_open_week: No open week at the moment.
da_ranking_hint: The leaderboard fills up as staff grades submissions. Every approved submission earns at least the participation floor.
da_no_closed_weeks: No closed week yet. The first close happens on the following Monday, or immediately via the Administration tab.
da_admin_only_bareme_desc: You do not have permission to configure the scoring scale of this module.
da_admin_only_module_desc: You do not have permission to configure this module.
da_score_preview_note: Preview: an average participant (3.4/5 avg, excluding speed podium) earns {weekday} pts on weekdays, {weekend} pts on weekends, for about {week} pts over a full week. Points are always integers, rounded up.
da_weekly_rewards_desc: Grants XP and roles upon Monday close. When disabled, the leaderboard is still locked and archived.
da_roles_optional_note: All three roles are optional: leaving a field empty means "no role", and other rewards are still granted.
da_rotating_roles_desc: Removes previous podium roles at each close. Without rotation, a champion role accumulates and loses its meaning.
da_podium_xp_note: The podium receives its dedicated XP instead of participation XP, not in addition.
da_clans_not_enabled_desc: Clans are not enabled on this server. Enable them in the Clans tab to configure this link. Daily Algo works perfectly without.
da_convert_clan_points_desc: At close, each participant converts their weekly points to clan points. Without this setting, both modules run independently.
da_clan_rate_note: Rate 1 = 1 Daily Algo point gives 1 clan point. An active participant carries about 70 clan points per week, slightly more than a level up.
da_close_week_desc: Immediately triggers Monday cron logic: locks leaderboard, awards rewards, assigns podium roles, and posts announcement. Useful to test full cycle without waiting 7 days. This action cannot be undone.
da_week_already_closed: Week {weekKey} is already closed. Submissions arriving since will be caught up by Monday's cron, or right now using the button below.
da_confirm_close_rewards_disabled: Rewards disabled: leaderboard will only be archived
da_confirm_close_clan_enabled: Weekly points will be converted to clan points
da_confirm_close_clan_disabled: No clan points will be awarded
da_confirm_close_catchup_note: Submissions arriving before Sunday will be caught up by Monday's cron - nothing will be lost
da_sanctions_desc: Applies to sanction triggered from validation message, in case of misconduct in a submission.
da_schedule_modal_desc: Upcoming challenges scheduled for the guild.
eve_quiz_editor_desc: Prepare your questions and publish the event to Discord.
eve_ctf_editor_desc: Prepare your challenges, set up flags, and publish the event to Discord.
eve_custom_editor_desc: Configure your event, announcement channel, and registration form.
eve_create_discord_event_desc: Adds the event to scheduled server events.
eve_send_announcement_embed_desc: Posts a message with announcement embed and registration button.
eve_question_text_ph: What is the capital of France?
eve_correct_answer_hint: Check the circle to the left of the correct answer.
eve_csv_format_error: Invalid CSV format. Required columns: 'Question', 'Option X', and 'Correct Answer'.
evc_custom_desc: Track registrations and manage your custom event.
evc_pilot_desc: Control quiz progression and view live results.
fb_canvas_empty_hint: Choose a question type from the tools to begin
sea_ranking_rp_hint: RP is reset when the season closes, unlike XP.
rep_no_votes_desc: Reputation votes between members will appear here.
eco_page_desc: The server currency, its shop, the black market and the players.
rpg_page_desc: Adventures, bestiary, raids, quests, titles and guilds.
eco_public_page_hint: Opens the clan RPG page: running raid, quests and where each clan stands.
eco_config_load_failed: The economy configuration could not be loaded. The values shown are the defaults and saving will fail: check that the database migrations are applied on this environment.
eco_quick_setup_desc: One rhythm sets the daily rewards, their cooldown and energy at once
eco_presets_desc: A pace sets the daily rewards, their cooldown and energy in one go. Click the one that suits you, then save.
eco_presets_save_hint: Nothing is applied until you save.
eco_presets_already_saved: This is already the saved configuration.
eco_presets_module_off: The module is off: enable it at the top of the page for the economy to run.
eco_presets_currency_note: Amounts are in {currency}. The currency name, its emoji and the RPG, shop and guild modules are never changed by a pace.
eco_preset_calm_desc: Modest rewards and one daily per day: the currency keeps its value over time.
eco_preset_standard_desc: The recommended values: a daily slightly more frequent than once a day, regular adventures.
eco_preset_generous_desc: Plenty of coins and back-to-back adventures, for a server starting out or wanting momentum.
eco_preset_custom_desc: Your own values, set one by one in the detailed configuration.
eco_item_black_market_title: Can appear on the black market
eco_item_black_market_desc: The black market cuts prices by 20 to 50%. Items granting XP or clan points are excluded by default, their price being the balancing lever.
eco_item_salvageable_desc: The player gets back half of the recipe's materials. Without a recipe, the item cannot be dismantled.
eco_reset_bestiary_desc: Deletes creatures made here and restores the built-in bosses
eco_item_module_rewards_desc: Rewards granted by neighbouring modules when the item is consumed. An item carrying one disappears from the shop while its module is off.
eco_item_clan_points_bridge_off: RPG clan points are suspended: enable them in the Bosses & Monsters tab for this item to be sellable.
eco_item_module_locked_warning: Removed from the shop: the module granting its reward is disabled.
eco_bestiary_clan_bridge_desc: Grants the winner's clan the reward set on each creature. Turning this off suspends the RPG's contribution to the ranking without zeroing every reward.
eco_bestiary_clan_points_hint: Granted to the winner's clan. A player without a clan earns nothing.
eco_bestiary_guild_xp_hint: Paid to the winner's RPG guild, levelling it up. A player without a guild brings nothing.
eco_bestiary_clan_points_off: Clan points are suspended: turn on the switch at the top of this tab for this reward to be granted.
eco_bestiary_desc: Creatures shipped with the bot are shared by every server. Customising one here creates a copy owned by this server without touching the original: Reset brings it back at any time.
eco_bestiary_difficulty_desc: Each tier rewrites the stats, rewards, loot chances and respawn delay of every creature in the category at once. Nothing is locked: a creature can still be edited afterwards, and the next tier starts from your own tweaks. Bosses and monsters are set separately.
eco_bestiary_difficulty_easy_desc: Short fights, for a server that is starting out or plays now and then.
eco_bestiary_difficulty_normal_desc: The balance shipped with the bot, neither forgiving nor punishing.
eco_bestiary_difficulty_hard_desc: Creatures that take a beating and hit back, but pay more.
eco_bestiary_difficulty_confirm_desc: Every creature in this category will have its stats rewritten, including the ones you already customised: their gaps are kept proportionally. Creatures shipped with the bot are copied into this server so the shared catalogue stays untouched.
eco_difficulty_protected_drops: {count} loot entr(y/ies) will stay untouched: they pay out XP or clan points.
eco_difficulty_protected_items: {count} item(s) will keep their price: they sell a module reward.
eco_difficulty_advice: Your players win {rate}% of their {battles} fights over the last {days} days: the {difficulty} tier would suit them better.
eco_difficulty_advice_ok: {rate}% wins over {battles} fights in the last {days} days: the current tier holds up.
eco_difficulty_advice_none: Not enough fights over {days} days to recommend a tier yet.
eco_difficulty_level_hint: Low-level creatures only take part of the tier ({floor}% at level 1), so the early game stays open.
eco_difficulty_protected_hint: Clan points, and loot that grants XP or clan points, are never touched.
eco_bestiary_badge_tuned_hint: These stats are no longer the ones the tier would set: they were adjusted by hand.
eco_bestiary_export_hint: Downloads this server's bestiary as JSON.
eco_bestiary_import_hint: Replaces creatures with the same name and adds the rest.
eco_bestiary_import_invalid: This file is not a readable JSON bestiary.
eco_bestiary_import_confirm_desc: Creatures with the same name are replaced, the others added. Nothing is deleted. Loot whose item does not exist on this server is stripped on import.
eco_bestiary_import_dropped_loot: {count} loot entr(y/ies) removed: their item does not exist on this server.
eco_shop_difficulty_desc: The same setting as the bestiary, applied to item prices. It is independent from the boss and monster tiers.
eco_shop_difficulty_scope_hint: Only items created on this server are affected: the shipped catalogue is shared with other servers and cannot be copied the way the bestiary is. Items that sell level XP or clan points keep their price.
eco_shop_difficulty_confirm_desc: Prices of the items created on this server will be rewritten.
eco_shop_difficulty_toast_catalog_only: Tier saved, but no price moved. This setting does not touch the {count} items of the built-in catalogue, which is shared with other servers.
eco_bestiary_reset_confirm: Restore “{name}” to the built-in version? This server's settings for that creature will be lost.
eco_bestiary_delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? It will disappear from fights and from player bestiaries.
eco_bestiary_name_locked: A built-in creature cannot be renamed: the name is what links it back to the original.
eco_bestiary_is_boss_desc: A boss is picked from the Boss menu, costs energy and only respawns after a delay.
eco_bestiary_enabled_desc: An inactive creature no longer shows up in fights or in the boss list.
eco_bestiary_drops_desc: One loot at most is rolled per victory, in list order. The item must exist in the shop or in the global catalogue.
eco_bestiary_drops_max: A monster cannot have more than {max} loot entries.
eco_bestiary_drops_empty: No loot: victory only grants XP and coins.
rpg_public_solo_empty: Nobody has started the adventure yet.
rpg_public_unavailable: This information is not available right now.
rpg_public_disabled: The RPG is not enabled on this server.
rpg_public_raid_open: Raid running, level {level}. Each clan faces its own instance of the boss.
rpg_public_raid_guild_mode: Raid running, level {level}. It is played in RPG guilds: clans are not pitted against each other.
rpg_public_raid_none: No window is open or scheduled right now.
eco_quests_desc: Game goals to reach within a time window: monsters killed, bosses downed, raid assaults, loot, fishing. A quest counts for one member, or for a whole clan pushing the same counter.
eco_quests_clans_off: The Clans module is off: team quests can only target RPG guilds, and no clan points will be paid.
eco_quests_empty: No quest: nothing is offered to players.
eco_quest_scope_member_desc: Each member has their own progress. The reward is paid automatically once the target is reached.
eco_quest_scope_team_desc: The whole team pushes the same counter. The reward is split in proportion and paid automatically.
eco_recipes_desc: What a player can craft at the workshop, from materials looted off monsters or bought.
eco_recipes_empty: No recipe. The server only uses the ones shipped with the bot.
eco_recipe_shipped_hint: Shipped recipes are shared by every server and cannot be edited here.
eco_recipe_material_required: Every material must name an item.
eco_quest_window_hint: The window is clock-aligned: 24 h resets at midnight UTC, 6 h at 00, 06, 12 and 18. Every team runs the same clock.
eco_quest_rewards_bridge_hint: Clan points are only paid while the RPG to clans bridge is open, in the Bosses & Monsters tab.
eco_quest_rewards_member_hint: Paid automatically on the action that reaches the target, with nothing for the player to do.
eco_quest_repeatable_on_desc: The quest resets as soon as it pays out: the player can run it as many times as they like inside the window.
eco_quest_repeatable_off_desc: The quest pays once every 24 h. Finished sooner, it waits out the delay before paying.
eco_quest_rewards_team_hint: Pools shared between participants: 30% split evenly, the rest in proportion to what each brought. Paid automatically on completion.
eco_quest_enabled_desc: A disabled quest is no longer offered and stops counting.
eco_quest_delete_confirm: Delete \u00ab {name} \u00bb? Progress in flight disappears with it.
eco_quest_team_unavailable: No team module is enabled for this mode: the quest would never count anything.
eco_raid_desc: Once a week a boss opens for a few hours. Each team faces its own instance, with a health pool that follows its size: every team runs the same trial, and the largest one cannot monopolise the health bar.
eco_raid_toggle_desc: Requires a team module: server clans, or RPG guilds.
eco_raid_mode_clan_desc: Membership is read from the Discord role. Rewards go through clan points, with the season, the standings and debt repayment.
eco_raid_mode_clan_off: The Clans module is off: turn it on to use this mode.
eco_raid_mode_guild_desc: Membership is read from the game profile. Team points go to guild XP instead of clan points.
eco_raid_mode_guild_off: RPG guilds are off: turn them on in the Configuration tab.
eco_raid_auto_desc: The raid opens on the configured day and hour. Turn this off to launch it by hand only.
eco_raid_start_hint: The window opens right away and the announcement is posted at once in the chosen channel.
eco_raid_start_unsaved: Save your settings first: the launch uses what is saved, not what is on screen.
eco_raid_start_confirm_desc: The announcement goes out immediately and the window stays open for {hours} h. A launched raid cannot be taken back.
eco_raid_window_hint: The hour follows the server timezone. The next raid is scheduled as soon as the previous one closes.
eco_item_raid_assaults_hint: Drunk during an open raid, the potion grants these assaults on top of the quota. The server caps it at {max} per member per raid.
eco_raid_bought_assaults_hint: Cap on the assaults a member can buy through potions on one raid. At zero, nothing can be bought.
eco_raid_health_preview: A team of 3 faces {small} HP, a team of 20 faces {large}.
eco_raid_rewards_hint: Amounts are set per member: a team's pool follows its size, just like its health reserve. It is shared between participants, 30% split evenly and the rest in proportion to damage. A team that fails to bring the boss down gets a quarter.
eco_raid_reward_points_hint: Paid member by member, to their clan and for the current season.
eco_raid_reward_guild_xp_hint: Paid to the RPG guild that led the raid, levelling it up.
eco_raid_announce_hint: The message carries the assault button and each team's progress bar. Without an announcement, nobody can strike.
eco_raid_consolation_hint: Share of the pool paid to a team that struck without bringing its boss down. At zero, only victory pays.
eco_raid_recap_closed: Ended on {date}. These results stay until the next raid opens.
eco_raid_bosses_desc: These sheets belong to this server. Spells are picked from the shipped catalogue: they give each boss its way of fighting, not just its numbers.
eco_raid_restore_hint: Puts back the shipped bosses that are missing, without touching yours.
eco_raid_restore_none: Every shipped boss is already here.
eco_raid_no_boss: No raid boss: the raid cannot open.
eco_raid_no_spell: No spell: the boss only hits.
eco_raid_spells_desc: One spell per turn, when it is off cooldown. Phase spells take priority, which makes the end of a fight differ from its start.
eco_raid_enabled_desc: A disabled boss is never drawn.
eco_raid_delete_confirm: Delete \u00ab {name} \u00bb? Past raids keep their record.
eco_bm_desc: A clandestine stall opening at unpredictable days and times. Every member sees their own selection of shop items, heavily discounted and in limited supply.
eco_bm_toggle_desc: Requires the RPG shop: offers are drawn from purchasable items.
eco_bm_requires_shop: Enable the RPG shop first in the Configuration tab: with no purchasable items, the black market has nothing to offer.
eco_bm_interval_hint: Average gap between two openings. The exact moment stays random.
eco_bm_duration_hint: Window during which members can buy.
eco_toast_bm_discount_invalid: The minimum discount must be lower than or equal to the maximum discount.
eco_toast_bm_channel_required: Select an announcement channel for the black market.
eco_toast_bm_role_required: Select a role to mention for the black market.
eco_rpg_toggle_desc: Unlocks the /rpg-travel command and random events.
eco_rpg_channels_desc: Channels where /rpg, /raid, /market and /tower can be used, threads included. Leave empty to allow them everywhere. Server administrators are not affected.
eco_rpg_channels_diverged: /rpg, /raid, /market and /tower have different channels, set from the Command access page. Saving here will apply the same list to all of them.
eco_shop_toggle_desc: Allows buying gear, equipping weapons, and using potions.
eco_guilds_toggle_desc: Allows forming alliances, cooperating, and having a guild chest.
eco_icon_hint: PNG, JPG, or SVG. Displayed with priority on the dashboard.
eco_limits_desc: Caps applied to gambling games and member-to-member transfers.
eco_max_daily_bets: Games per day and per member
eco_market_tax_hint: Share of the price withheld from the seller on each sale (0 to 50). These coins are removed, which curbs inflation.
eco_fight_timers_desc: Waiting times between two fights. Monsters and bosses each have their own.
eco_fight_cd_hint: 0 = monster fights back to back, no waiting.
eco_boss_cd_hint: 0 = chain different bosses. Each boss's respawn time still applies.
eco_titles_desc: A title is shown at the top of the character card and can grant stats. Only the title worn counts. Players earn titles by defeating the creatures that give them, or from you directly.
eco_title_delete_confirm: Delete the title “{name}”? Players who own it will lose it.
eco_title_name_hint: {count} / 24 characters, to fit on the character card
eco_title_bonuses_hint: Added to the player's stats while they wear this title. Leave at 0 for a purely cosmetic title.
eco_bestiary_win_title_hint: Given to every player who defeats this creature, once per player.
eco_bestiary_title_empty: Create a title in the Titles tab first
eco_first_kill_announce_desc: Posts a message when a player is the first on the server to defeat a creature or clear a dungeon, and wins a bounty for it. Without a bounty, nothing is posted. Dungeons follow the boss setting.
eco_toast_first_kill_channel_required: Select an announcement channel for the first kill.
eco_bestiary_first_kill_desc: A bounty paid only once, to the first player on the server who defeats this creature, on top of the usual rewards.
eco_bestiary_first_kill_role_hint: The bot's role must be above this role. A role granting the Administrator permission is refused.
eco_reset_section_desc: Irreversible actions. Allows resetting all or part of the server economy.
eco_players_reset_all_hint: Erases stored RPG profiles: balances, levels, inventories. The search box does not narrow it down, every player in the list is affected.
eco_reset_titles_desc: Deletes every title, and removes it from players, creatures and adventures
eco_no_items: No items available in the shop.
eco_no_attrs_needed: No specific attributes required for this item.
eco_reset_modal_desc: Are you sure you want to reset component {component}? This operation will permanently delete associated data and is completely irreversible!
eco_toast_daily_invalid: Maximum daily reward must be greater than or equal to minimum reward.
eco_toast_raid_channel_required: Pick an announcement channel for the raid: that is where it gets attacked from.
eco_toast_raid_announce_required: The raid is fought from its announcement button: pick an announcement mode.
eco_toast_raid_team_mode_off: The team module picked for the raid is off: turn it on, switch mode, or disable the raid.
eco_toast_raid_role_required: Pick a role to mention for the raid.
eco_delete_item_confirm: Delete this item from the shop? It will also disappear from the inventories of players who own it.
que_page_desc: Daily and weekly quests with rewards.
que_template_subtitle: Select a pre-configured template or create a custom quest
que_numbers_invalid: Target and rewards must be valid numbers
mar_empty_listings_desc: Players can create listings using the /market command.
giv_page_desc: Create and manage interactive raffles with entry buttons.
giv_empty_text: No giveaways configured at the moment.
giv_modal_subtitle: Configure and deploy a giveaway on Discord.
giv_field_end_at_help: The giveaway closes at this date. It must be in the future, and at most a year away.
giv_field_end_at_invalid: Pick an end date in the future, at most a year away.
giv_cfg_default_channel_help: Offered by default when launching a giveaway. It stays editable each time, and a template carrying its own channel takes precedence.
giv_cfg_managers_desc: Who can start, end, reroll and delete a giveaway.
giv_cfg_managers_help: These roles add to administrators and members with “Manage Messages”. They get the /giveaway command on Discord and the actions on this page.
giv_cfg_participation_desc: Who can click a giveaway's “Join” button.
giv_cfg_required_help: Leave empty to open giveaways to the whole server.
giv_cfg_blocked_help: Take priority over required roles: an excluded member can never join.
giv_cfg_save_modal_desc: These settings are applied to the server and kept aside under this name. Saves already stored are left untouched.
giv_cfg_preset_error_name: A save already goes by that name.
giv_cfg_presets_desc: Every save keeps a named copy of these settings. One button puts it back, with nothing to type again.
giv_cfg_presets_empty: No save yet. The next save will create one.
giv_cfg_preset_preview_toggle: Show what this save looks like
giv_cfg_preset_confirm_apply_backup: The settings in place are saved nowhere: they are set aside under “{name}” before being replaced.
giv_cfg_preset_confirm_apply_desc: Current settings are replaced by the ones in this save, and giveaways already posted take on its look.
giv_cfg_preset_confirm_delete_desc: The configuration currently live on the server is left untouched.
giv_case_error: Could not load the member file
giv_public_page_desc: Share the list of running giveaways, no login or dashboard access needed.
giv_cfg_requirements_desc: Account age and level required before clicking Join.
giv_cfg_min_account_age_help: 0 to require nothing. Keeps out accounts made for the occasion.
giv_cfg_min_member_age_help: 0 to require nothing. Keeps out members who joined just for the giveaway.
giv_cfg_min_level_help: 0 to require nothing. Uses the level from the Levels module.
giv_cfg_bonus_desc: Roles whose holders count several times in the draw.
giv_cfg_bonus_empty: No favoured role: everyone has the same odds.
giv_cfg_bonus_help: The best role applies, roles do not stack. The winning clan bonus then doubles those chances.
giv_cfg_appearance_desc: Colours, title and images of the message posted on Discord.
giv_cfg_description_help: The main text of the announcement, between the title and the button. Every inserted variable is replaced when sending, and vanishes when it has nothing to show.
giv_cfg_images_help: HTTPS addresses only. An invalid address is ignored.
giv_cfg_button_desc: What members click to enter the draw.
giv_cfg_button_emoji_help: Pick from the server emojis or the Unicode catalogue. The emoji also shows on the greyed button once the giveaway ends.
giv_cfg_texts_desc: What the bot replies to entrants and announces when the draw closes.
giv_cfg_denied_desc: Explain how to become eligible rather than refusing without a reason.
giv_cfg_linked_help: Accounts recognised as the same member in the Moderation section enter only once, and count only once in the draw.
giv_form_rewards_toggle: This giveaway also grants RPG module rewards
giv_form_extras_help: Staff validation, draw and RPG module rewards for this giveaway. Rarely needed.
giv_form_rewards_help: Rarely needed: most giveaways offer a prize handed over by hand, touching nothing in the server economy.
giv_tpl_desc: A template is a launch set aside: the same fields, saved under a name. You write and fix them here; to reuse one, open "Launch a giveaway" and pick it at the top of the form.
giv_tpl_confirm_delete_desc: Giveaways already started from it are left untouched.
giv_tpl_validation_label: Require staff validation before handing out the prize
giv_tpl_apply_help: The template fills in every field below. Nothing is locked: change what you want before launching.
macro_field_help: Hover a variable to see what it shows, click to insert it at the cursor.
giv_macro_host: Mention of whoever started the giveaway
giv_macro_ends_relative: The time left, which updates on its own
giv_macro_description: The description typed when starting the giveaway
giv_macro_bonus: The RPG module rewards block, when the giveaway grants any
giv_macro_bonus_roles: The block listing roles with extra chances
giv_macro_min_account_age: The days required on the Discord account
giv_macro_min_member_age: The days required on the server
giv_cfg_title_help: The first line of the announcement, bold and large.
giv_cfg_footer_help: The small grey line at the very bottom of the announcement. It carries the giveaway identifier, the one the end and reroll commands ask for.
giv_cfg_thumbnail_help: Small square image, top right of the announcement.
giv_cfg_image_help: Large image shown under the text, full width.
giv_cfg_button_label_help: The text written on the button, 80 characters at most.
giv_cfg_announce_winners_help: Message posted in the channel when the giveaway draws winners.
giv_cfg_announce_no_winner_help: Message posted when the giveaway ends with no entrant at all.
giv_cfg_join_reply_help: Seen by that entrant alone, the moment they join.

prg_global_empty: No member on the global leaderboard yet.
prg_global_opted_out: This server does not take part in the global leaderboard: turn the option on in the Announcements tab.
prg_member_history_empty: No RP movement recorded in the last 30 days.
prg_member_not_found: This member has no RP on this server yet.
prg_member_adjust_hint: An adjustment goes through the same path as a normal gain: it can trigger a tier change, a role and an announcement.
prestige_public_error_loading: Could not load the prestige leaderboard.
prestige_public_disabled_desc: This server has not enabled the prestige leaderboard, or has made it private.
no_guild_access_desc: Your Discord account has no permissions on any server where Kotbo is installed. Ask an administrator to grant you a role, or invite the bot to your server, then try again.
no_feature_access_desc: Your role on this server does not grant access to this page. Contact a server administrator if you think this is a mistake.
clan_bets_desc: Two members challenge each other on any subject and stake clan points. Only a referee settles it.
clan_bets_requires_clans: The Clans module is off: bets stay inactive until it is turned back on.
clan_bets_channel_desc: Channel where the /paris command is accepted. With no setting, it works in every channel, and the bet is posted where it was started.
clan_bets_announcement_desc: Channel for the summary posted once the verdict is in. With no setting, it appears in the channel where the bet was opened.
clan_bets_shapes_desc: Duels are always available. Other formats settle the same way: the winning side shares the pot.
clan_bets_allow_pool_desc: Several bettors, a single winner who takes the whole pot.
clan_bets_allow_teams_desc: Sides facing off. The winning side shares the pot in proportion to what each member staked.
clan_bets_allow_open_desc: Allow duels started with no named opponent, which anyone can take up. Pools and teams are always open, under their own setting.
clan_bets_stake_mode_desc: Per person: everyone stakes the same amount, so an outnumbered side gets better odds. Per side: the stake is split across the side's seats, which requires declaring how many there are when the bet is created.
clan_bets_max_participants_desc: Caps the size of the pot, across all seats.
clan_bets_max_sides_desc: Each side gets its own button in the announcement: beyond that it becomes unreadable.
clan_bets_reward_desc: When a season closes, the top bettors receive a title and a bonus. Only a positive net gain is rewarded: a season where everyone lost crowns nobody.
clan_bets_reward_role_desc: Optional: with no role, only the bonuses are paid, and if the bonuses are zero the podium is simply announced. The role is removed from its previous holders at every closure, like the clan leader role, then given to the winner - or to all of them on a tie.
clan_bets_reward_amounts_desc: Clan points paid into the next season: credited to the one just closed, they would show up in no readable ranking. Leave at zero to award the title only. A bettor in debt sees the bonus go to repayment first.
clan_bets_debt_desc: Allows staking more points than a member holds. The shortfall becomes a debt, taken from later gains.
clan_bets_max_debt_desc: Maximum debt per member. Past it, no further bet on credit is accepted.
clan_bets_debt_reset_desc: Off, a debt survives seasons: otherwise waiting for the close is enough to owe nothing.
clan_bets_debt_clear_desc: The firm share disappears with nothing in return: nobody pays it back.
clan_bets_debt_clear_engaged_note: {amount} point(s) are still staked on running bets. Without the box below, that share stays owed until the bet is settled.
clan_bets_debt_clear_include_engaged: also clear the debt from their running bets
clan_bets_debt_cleared_partial: Firm debt cleared. {amount} point(s) remain staked on running bets.
clan_bets_managers_desc: Hand refereeing to a team without opening up server administration.
clan_bets_managers_scope_winner: Name the winner of a running bet.
clan_bets_managers_scope_cancel: Cancel a bet and return both stakes.
clan_bets_managers_empty: No role: only administrators can manage bets.
clan_bets_managers_admin_note: Administrators keep this right in every case.
clan_points_debt_repaid: Points added, but {amount} went to repaying the member's debt.
drop_page_desc: Randomly drop XP, clan points or coins into your channels and let members claim them.
drop_type_desc_rpg_item: A game item drops in the channel and lands in the winner's inventory. Only the items you list can drop.
drop_item_pool_desc: The drop picks one at random each time it appears. With an empty list, no item drop is published.
drop_item_pool_empty: No item selected: this drop type will publish nothing.
drop_item_total_error: Rates must add up to 100%, they currently add up to {total}.
drop_item_pool_full: You can list up to {max} items.
drop_item_pool_rpg_off: The RPG is disabled: a dropped item would have no inventory to land in, and nothing will be published.
drop_item_quantity_hint: The amounts below are a number of copies, not points.
drop_global_desc: Apply to all four drop types. Each type keeps its own channel, frequency and amounts.
drop_enable_desc: Master switch: turned off here, no drop appears, whatever each type is set to.
drop_default_channel_desc: Used by drop types that have no channel of their own.
drop_mention_role_desc: Pinged on every drop. Leave empty to notify nobody.
drop_lifetime_desc: After that, an unclaimed drop closes. The open-to-all mode has its own duration.
drop_delete_after_desc: A finished drop's message can be deleted after a delay, to keep the channel clear. The winners recap goes with it. The setting only applies to drops posted afterwards.
drop_overview_desc: Status of the four drop types configured on this server.
drop_history_desc: What actually landed in your channels, and how many members claimed it.
drop_type_enable_desc: Enables drops of this resource. The master switch must be on as well.
drop_type_desc_xp: Progression XP: counts towards levels and role rewards.
drop_type_desc_rpg_xp: RPG module XP, independent from server levels.
drop_type_desc_clan_points: Clan points credited to the claimer's clan. They show up tagged as Drop on the public page.
drop_type_desc_coins: Economy currency, credited to the member's balance.
drop_channel_desc: Leave on the default channel to follow the global setting.
drop_interval_desc: Average gap between two drops. The exact time is drawn between half and one and a half times this interval, so nobody can camp the channel.
drop_interval_hint: About {count} drop(s) per day on average.
drop_min_gap_hint: Two drops on the same server never land less than five minutes apart, all types combined.
drop_no_mode_warning: No claim mode is active: this type will not produce any drop.
drop_no_channel_warning: No channel for this type and no default channel: drops would be posted nowhere.
drop_clans_disabled_warning: Clans are disabled: a clan points drop would credit nobody.
drop_module_disabled_warning: The {module} module is disabled: the reward would still be credited, but members could not use it while it stays off.
drop_modes_desc: Enable one or several. On each drop the bot picks one at random among those enabled, using the reward range set here.
drop_mode_first_desc: A single winner: the first to click takes it all.
drop_mode_race_desc: The first to click each receive the announced amount.
drop_mode_window_desc: Anyone can help themselves for the given duration.
drop_min_open_hint: Five minutes minimum: below that, only members already watching the channel would get a chance to click.
drop_save_error: Error while saving the drops configuration.
clan_public_credit_share_desc: Share of this stake paid with points the member did not have. It stays out of the score and will be taken from their next gains.
clan_public_debt_clan_clear: No member of this clan is in debt.
clan_public_debt_empty: Nobody owes points on this server.
clan_public_debt_unaffiliated_desc: Debt follows the member, not the clan: they carry it into whichever clan they join next.
clan_public_credit_badge_hint: Points this clan's members still owe from betting on credit. They are not part of the total shown: betting on credit adds nothing to the bettor's score. Credit staked on unsettled bets is left out too, as long as the verdict can wipe it.
clan_public_bettors_desc: Net gains for the season. A win pays the opponent's stake, never your own.
clan_public_bettors_rewards: Podium rewarded at season close: {top1} / {top2} / {top3} clan points.
clan_public_bettors_rewards_role: The winner also gets the {role} role.
clan_public_bets_desc: Who challenged whom, on what, and for how much.
clan_public_debt_engaged_desc: Share of the debt staked on unsettled bets: it vanishes if the bet falls through or when the season ends.
clan_public_debt_average_hint: What an indebted member owes on average, taken from their next clan-point gains.
clan_board_empty_desc: This server has enabled neither clans nor the RPG. As soon as one of them is open, the ranking, raids and quests appear here.
cm_bc_desc: Every channel and what is active on it. The one-of-a-kind features (a counter, the honeypot channel…) move: turning one on here takes it off the channel that had it.
cm_bc_also_carries: This channel also has: {items}. They are configured in their own tab.
cm_bc_cannot_edit: The bot cannot edit this channel
cm_bc_cannot_delete: The bot cannot delete this channel
cm_bc_delete_confirm_desc: The channel and all its messages are permanently lost. This cannot be undone.
mcm_xlink_score_hint: Bonus added to the detection score: it grows with the number of servers carrying this link.
mcm_xlink_apply_reason: Link already present on {count} other server(s): {servers}
mcm_xlink_footer_hint: Nothing is linked automatically - you decide.
starboard_page_desc: Reposts the messages people react to as highlights, in a dedicated channel.
starboard_load_error: Could not load the Starlight configuration.
starboard_section_publication_desc: Where highlighted messages are reposted, and from which score.
starboard_channel_hint: Without a channel the module stays idle: nothing gets published.
starboard_threshold_hint: Score (upvotes minus downvotes) required to get reposted.
starboard_section_votes_desc: Which emojis count, and where they count.
starboard_upvotes_hint: At least one is required. The first one is used as the highlight counter.
starboard_downvotes_hint: Subtracted from the score. Leave empty to disable downvoting.
starboard_count_embed_desc: Votes cast on the reposted message feed the same score. That is often where members vote.
starboard_section_autoreact_desc: Add the vote emojis upfront, so nobody has to look for them.
starboard_autoreact_embed_desc: The bot adds the vote emojis to every reposted message.
starboard_autoreact_channels_hint: Every new message there gets the vote emojis: this is what turns a channel into a suggestion box.
starboard_section_scope_desc: Which channels are watched, and which are excluded.
starboard_watched_hint: Leave empty to watch the whole server.
starboard_ignored_hint: Always take precedence over watched channels.
starboard_allow_bots_desc: Take messages posted by bots and webhooks into account.
starboard_section_lifecycle_desc: What happens to a highlight whose score drops back down.
starboard_remove_below_desc: The highlight is deleted if the score falls back under the threshold. Otherwise it stays published once reached.
starboard_no_channel_warning: Without a publishing channel, Starlight reposts nothing. Pick one below.
ba_contested_hint: Each sanction gets its own verdict. Apply them, then issue the overall decision to notify the member.
ba_item_sanction_gone: This sanction was deleted from the database.
ba_item_delete_desc: The sanction will disappear from the record and cannot be restored. Prefer archiving if you want to keep a trace.
ba_scope_desc: Enable, one by one, the sanction types members can appeal. With nothing but Ban ticked, the module behaves exactly as before.
ba_dm_on_sanction_desc: On every appealable sanction, the member gets a link to the appeal page, already pointing at the right sanction.
ba_exclude_moderator: Bar moderators from judging their own sanction
ba_exclude_moderator_desc: Whoever issued the sanction cannot decide the appeal against it.
ba_notify_moderator_desc: They get a DM when one of their sanctions is appealed, and can add context before the verdict.
ba_mod_stats_desc: A high overturn rate points at poorly issued sanctions, not at a lenient staff.
pa_pick_sanctions_desc: Tick the ones you want to appeal ({count} at most) and explain your side for each.
pa_statement_placeholder: Why do you feel this sanction was unfair?
pa_select_sanction: Select at least one sanction to appeal.
pa_max_sanctions: You can only appeal {count} sanction(s) at a time.
pa_nothing_desc: You have no appealable sanction on this server right now.
sc_bulk_archive_desc: They leave the active record and stop counting towards the warn score, but stay stored and readable.
sc_bulk_unarchive_title: Restore these infractions to the active record?
sc_bulk_unarchive_desc: They count again towards the warn score and automatic escalation.
sc_bulk_lock_desc: The member will never be able to appeal these infractions again, even after the waiting period.
sc_bulk_unlock_desc: The member will be able to request a review again.
sc_bulk_delete_desc: The infractions disappear from the database and cannot be restored. Prefer archiving to keep a trace.
da_warn_auto_archive_hint: Past this delay a warn is archived automatically: it leaves the active record without being erased. Empty or 0 = never.
da_count_archived_desc: By default an archived sanction no longer weighs on the warn score or escalation. Tick this to keep it counting (purely visual archiving).
commands_info_discord: You can also manage these permissions directly in Discord (Server Settings → Integrations).
commands_roles_hint: No role selected = default Discord behaviour (based on the command permissions). Administrators always keep access to enabled commands.
commands_disabled_notice: Command turned off for the whole server, administrators included. Re-enable it to configure access.
mgmt_page_desc: Cross-cutting settings for the server, its modules and their access.
mgmt_no_access_desc: Administrative permissions are required for this area.
mgmt_preset_confirm_desc: Current access rules will be overwritten, and pending changes lost.
ma_hint_open: No rule: every staff member sees this section. Granting "View" to a role closes it to all the others.
ma_hint_restricted: Allowlist active: only roles with "View" reach this section. Discord administrators are never filtered out.
onb_tracks_title: What would you like to set up today?
onb_tracks_lead: Everything can also be configured later, from the dashboard. Whatever you tick here, we set up together now.
onb_tracks_group_hint: Unticking disables nothing: we simply won't ask the question.
onb_tracks_none: Nothing ticked: you'll go straight to activation.
onb_track_structure_outcome: Kotbo lays out a full tree before your eyes, permissions included.
onb_track_moderation_outcome: Spam, invite links and suspicious join waves are blocked without you.
onb_track_logs_outcome: A deleted message stays readable, and every action lands in a log channel.
onb_track_greeting_pitch: The first message a newcomer reads
onb_track_greeting_outcome: Every new member is greeted by name, in the channel you choose.
onb_track_rules_outcome: A complete set of rules, published in its channel, that you never had to write.
onb_track_tickets_outcome: Members open a private ticket in one click, with your reasons and your colour.
onb_track_levels_outcome: Active members level up and earn roles, on their own.
onb_track_economy_outcome: Your own currency, a /daily and a shop to spend it in.
onb_track_animation_outcome: Goals that renew every day and rewards that land in the channel.
onb_track_staff_outcome: Kotbo knows who moderates, and gives you their activity statistics.
onb_track_mcp_pitch: Your Discord from Claude or ChatGPT
onb_track_mcp_outcome: “How many messages this week?” — ask an AI, it reads your server.
onb_migration_bots_title: Let's see what's already running here
onb_migration_bots_lead: Your server isn't empty, and Kotbo shouldn't pretend otherwise. Here's what it recognised.
onb_migration_bots_none_lead: Nothing to recover on that side: we start from what the server already holds.
onb_migration_findings_lead: Nothing is written without your say-so. Untick whatever you'd rather set up yourself.
onb_migration_findings_none: Nothing to recover automatically: your setup happens on the next screens.
onb_migration_manual_title: What will still need doing by hand
onb_migration_manual_hint: Kotbo can't guess these without risking a mistake. We'll come back to them from the dashboard.
onb_logs_title: What should be kept of what's said?
onb_logs_lead: A deleted message is only lost if nobody wrote it down. Kotbo keeps a copy, for as long as you decide.
onb_logs_channel_hint: Staff only: Kotbo writes deletions, joins and sanctions there.
onb_logs_channel_none: No channel — publish nothing on Discord
onb_logs_retention_short_detail: The useful minimum: a weekend report is still actionable on Monday. Beyond that, everything is erased.
onb_logs_retention_standard_detail: Covers almost every report, without keeping years of conversations.
onb_logs_retention_long_detail: For an exposed server, or when disputes go back a long way. Remember to tell your members.
onb_staff_lead: Point out your team's roles: Kotbo will know who to alert, and will track each person's activity.
onb_staff_empty: No roles to offer yet. Kotbo may have created one during the build: it will show up after a refresh.
onb_staff_alert_hint: Sanctions, reports and raid alerts land there.
onb_staff_mode_create_hint: Kotbo creates the roles, in order, with the right permissions.
onb_staff_mode_existing_hint: Tick the roles your team is already made of.
onb_staff_poles_hint: They sit between the admins and the moderators: high enough for their calls to carry, low enough for those calls to be reviewed.
onb_staff_ladder_hint: Roles are created top to bottom, in this exact order. You can rename them on Discord without breaking anything.
onb_staff_preview_hint: Kotbo will count sanctions, handled tickets and presence for every member of these roles.
onb_economy_lead: It's the word your members read on every gain, every purchase, every leaderboard. It may as well be yours.
onb_economy_rhythm_label: How fast do people earn it?
onb_economy_rhythm_discreet_detail: A modest /daily, once a day. What you buy is earned over time.
onb_economy_rhythm_standard_detail: A regular member affords their first item within the week, then picks their spending.
onb_economy_rhythm_generous_detail: Gains are visible on day one. Pick this if the shop is well stocked.
onb_economy_preview_daily_line: You received {amount} {currency}. Come back in {hours} h.
onb_economy_shop_lead: A currency that buys nothing is just a counter. Three items are enough to make it credible; the rest can come later.
onb_economy_shop_empty: No items selected: the shop stays empty for now.
onb_quests_title: Give them a reason to come back tomorrow
onb_quests_lead: Goals that renew every day. They target ordinary gestures: talking, reacting, joining voice.
onb_drops_lead: At unpredictable intervals, Kotbo posts a reward the first to react takes. It's an interruption: that's what makes it worth something.
onb_drops_rhythm_rare_detail: Rare enough that people look up. Pick this if the channel is already busy.
onb_drops_rhythm_standard_detail: The default rhythm: present without taking over.
onb_drops_rhythm_frequent_detail: Wakes up a quiet channel. On a busy one, it ends up cutting conversations short.
onb_drops_preview_line: First to click takes the reward.
onb_mcp_title: Run your Discord by talking to it
onb_mcp_lead: Kotbo exposes your server to an AI — Claude, ChatGPT, or any compatible client. You ask, it reads your data and answers.
onb_mcp_scope_label: What the AI will be allowed to do
onb_mcp_scope_read_detail: Statistics, members, tickets, economy. No sanctions, no messages posted. The recommended choice.
onb_mcp_scope_moderate_pitch: It can sanction and answer tickets
onb_mcp_scope_moderate_detail: Adds sanctions and ticket replies. An AI that gets it wrong bans someone: keep this for supervised use.
onb_mcp_scope_full_detail: It can write in your channels and edit your members. Only give this key to a client you control.
onb_mcp_key_warning: Copy it now: it won't be shown in full again. A lost key is replaced from the MCP page.
onb_mcp_url_label: Address to paste into your client
onb_mcp_example_1: How many new members this week?
onb_mcp_example_2: Which channel is busiest right now?
onb_mcp_example_3: Summarise the open tickets for me.
onb_mcp_preview_answer: 47 joins over the last 7 days, up 18 % on the previous week. The peak is Saturday evening, right after the announcement.
onb_sim_reason_young: Account created less than 24 h ago
onb_sim_caption_light: Light: only the obvious is blocked. The rest of the conversation goes through.
onb_sim_caption_standard: Balanced: spam, links and mention bursts are removed.
onb_sim_caption_strict: Strict: everything above, plus accounts that are too new held aside.
onb_recap_lead: Everything below is already running on {server}.
onb_recap_settings: {count} settings put in place in {minutes} minutes.
onb_recap_missing_hint: There's still time: these screens join the journey in one click.
ma_perm_view_desc: Open the section and read its data. Without it, the page leaves the navigation and the API refuses even reads.
ma_perm_moderate_desc: Act on what the section holds day to day - handle, decide, answer - without touching its settings.
ma_perm_configure_desc: Change the section settings. This is the right that allows saving, beyond plain reading.
ma_perm_delete_desc: Erase within the section: meetings, automations, staff ranks and warnings, quests, ticket macros and blacklist. A role that configures a section may still not erase from it.
mcp_key_orphan_hint: Key created before keys were tied to an account. It keeps answering even if whoever uses it loses access to the server: revoke and recreate it so it follows its holder.
mc_intro: A disabled module really does stop working: its commands, buttons, scheduled tasks and settings page all become unavailable.
mc_cat_core_desc: Foundations of the bot and the dashboard. Always on.
mc_cat_moderation_desc: Sanctions, logs, automatic filtering and server protection.
mc_cat_staff_desc: Recruitment, hierarchy, meetings, absences and team follow-up.
mc_cat_community_desc: Progression, economy, games, events and member interactions.
mc_cat_content_desc: Rules, welcome, news, auto-responses and publishing.
mc_cat_integrations_desc: External services plugged into the server.
mc_presets_desc: Applies a set of modules and permissions suited to a type of server in one go. Replaces the settings involved.
mc_preset_general_desc: Translation on, dev modules idle, admin commands kept in check.
mc_preset_gaming_desc: Translation on, simple moderation stack, focus on player channels.
mc_preset_dev_desc: Daily Algo and Code Police on, technical commands open.
mc_preset_confirm_desc: Some current settings will be replaced.
mc_state_plan_desc: This module is not part of the server's current plan.
mc_state_core_desc: Core module: it cannot be turned off.
mc_state_active_desc: Commands, events and settings page available.
mc_state_inactive_desc: Commands refused, events ignored, page unreachable.
mc_role_access_desc: Who can view, moderate and configure this module from the dashboard.
mc_confirm_disable_desc: Will be turned off at the same time: {list}.
mc_toast_toggle_error: Could not change the state of “{name}”.
us_timezone_desc: Chart and heatmap hours are shown in this time zone. Currently: {zone}.
mod_dashboard_desc: Dashboard home page and summary widgets.
mod_modules_desc: Turning the bot's modules on and configuring them.
mod_settings_desc: General server settings, system channels and base roles.
mod_commands_desc: Permissions and restrictions for Discord commands.
mod_activity_desc: Timestamped trail of staff actions on the dashboard and Discord.
mod_members_desc: Search, member profiles and individual moderation actions.
mod_profile_desc: Members' personal profile and account preferences.
mod_sanctions_desc: Warnings, mutes, bans, records and sanction reports.
mod_automod_desc: Automatic filtering: spam, links, caps, mentions, banned words.
mod_logs_desc: Discord event logs: messages, channels, roles, members.
mod_nickname_moderation_desc: Detecting and automatically renaming non-compliant nicknames.
mod_double_accounts_desc: Detecting multiple accounts and matching identities.
mod_raid_protection_desc: Detecting join waves and automatically locking the server down.
mod_ban_appeals_desc: Public appeal form and handling of the requests.
mod_codepolice_desc: Checking syntax and good practice on code snippets.
mod_security_verification_desc: Captcha and verification flow when members arrive.
mod_recruitment_desc: Staff applications, forms and interview follow-up.
mod_staff_directory_desc: List, profiles and statistics for the team.
mod_staff_roles_desc: Levels, promotions and staff role synchronisation.
mod_tutoring_desc: Trial periods, mentoring and follow-up for new staff.
mod_meetings_desc: Scheduling, invitations and minutes for team meetings.
mod_absences_desc: Declaring and tracking staff leave and unavailability.
mod_polls_desc: Internal team consultations with voting and closing.
mod_discipline_desc: Internal warnings, blacklist and team sanctions.
mod_evaluations_desc: Periodic reviews and ratings for team members.
mod_leveling_desc: Text and voice experience, levels and reward roles.
mod_seasons_desc: Time-limited competitive rankings and end-of-season rewards.
mod_prestige_desc: Prestige points, tiers, activity streaks and decay when inactive.
mod_clans_desc: Member teams, collective points and cross-clan ranking.
mod_drops_desc: Random gifts dropped in channels: XP, clan points or coins to pick up.
mod_economy_desc: Currency, shop, items, games of chance and text adventures.
mod_marketplace_desc: A marketplace where members trade items and currency.
mod_reputation_desc: Recognition points members give each other.
mod_fun_desc: Counting, one-word story, mystery number and channel mini-games.
mod_daily_algo_desc: Daily algorithm challenge, submissions and weekly ranking.
mod_tickets_desc: Support system with categories, handling and transcripts.
mod_giveaways_desc: Contests and prize draws entered with a button.
mod_suggestions_desc: Idea box with votes and staff replies.
mod_starboard_desc: Highlighting popular messages in a dedicated channel.
mod_regulation_desc: Writing, publishing and acknowledging the server rules.
mod_welcome_goodbye_desc: Welcome and farewell messages, menu and welcome thread.
mod_auto_thread_desc: Automatic threads, sticky messages, stat channels and temporary voice channels.
mod_news_desc: Staff article publishing and RSS feed generation.
mod_translation_desc: On-demand message translation into the configured language.
mod_analytics_desc: Collecting and presenting server activity statistics.
mod_twitch_desc: Automatic notifications when a stream goes live.
mod_social_networks_desc: Managing the YouTube and Twitch accounts the server follows.
mod_channel_health_desc: Detecting idle or overloaded channels and suggesting archiving.
mod_bump_reminder_desc: Detects bumps (Disboard, Discadia, DS.me, Disforge...) and pings again as soon as the server can bump.
mod_campaigns_desc: Sequences of scheduled messages sent to a targeted audience, with reach measured.
mod_channel_links_desc: Syncing messages between channels across several servers.
mod_staff_server_desc: A server dedicated to the team, with synced hierarchy and roles.
giv_tpl_modal_subtitle: The fields of a launch, saved under a name.
giv_tpl_name_help: This is the name you will pick at launch.
giv_tpl_channel_help: Optional: without a channel, the template takes the server one at launch.
giv_form_style_plain_help: The bot's factory announcement. Nothing from the Configuration tab applies to it.
giv_form_style_server_help: Whatever the Configuration tab holds. The giveaway follows when you change it there.
giv_form_style_custom_help: The fields below travel with the giveaway and stop moving, images included.
login_pitch_lead: Running your server is no longer
api_err_offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection, then try again.
api_err_timeout: The server did not respond in time. It may be overloaded: try again shortly.
api_err_unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
api_err_forbidden: You do not have the required permissions for this action.
api_err_not_found: This resource no longer exists. It may have been deleted in the meantime.
api_err_conflict: The action conflicts with the current state. Reload the page to start from up-to-date data.
api_err_rate_limited: Too many requests in a row. Wait a few seconds before trying again.
api_err_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable (database or bot unreachable). Try again in a few moments.
api_err_server: The server hit an error handling your request. The incident has been reported.
api_err_client: The request was rejected by the server.
api_err_parse: The server response could not be read. Reload the page.
api_err_write_blocked: Server unreachable: changes are blocked to avoid losing your data. They will resume once the connection is back.
backend_down_offline: Your browser has lost its internet connection. Displayed data may be stale and changes are blocked.
backend_down_timeout: The server has stopped responding. Displayed data may be stale and changes are blocked.
backend_down_unavailable: The service is unavailable (database or bot unreachable). Displayed data may be stale and changes are blocked.
eco_item_enchant_required: A scroll must name the enchantment it applies.
eco_events_desc: What happens to players at the end of a journey. Built-in events are shared by every server: customize them to make your own version, or disable them to take them out of the draw.
eco_events_empty: No events. Journeys then end without an encounter.
eco_events_disabled_hint: Out of the draw: no player will run into it.
eco_events_restore_confirm_desc: Your version is deleted and the built-in event goes back into the draw.
eco_events_title_locked_hint: A built-in event keeps its title: that is what makes your version replace the original.
eco_events_effects_hint: A negative value takes HP or coins away. A choice whose minimum level is too high stays visible but greyed out for players below it.
eco_guilds_desc: Guilds created by players. Fix a profile, adjust a treasury, change the leader or remove a member without resetting every guild.
eco_guilds_empty: No RPG guild on this server.
eco_guilds_dissolve_confirm_desc: Its {members} member(s) become guildless and keep their profile. The treasury ({treasury}) and the village are lost.
eco_inventory_remove_equipped_hint: This item is equipped: it will also leave its slot, and its forge level and enchantments will be lost.
eco_item_purchasable_hint: When off, the item is only obtained as loot, by crafting, as a reward or as a gift.
eco_player_base_stats_hint: These are base stats: gear, class and village are added on top in game.
eco_fish_desc: What bites when a player goes fishing. Built-in species can be customized or disabled, and you can create your own. Each rarity has a fixed chance, shared between its enabled species.
eco_fish_rarity_empty: No species: this rarity never comes up.
eco_fish_restore_confirm_desc: Your changes are discarded. Players keep their catches.
eco_fish_delete_confirm: Delete "{name}"? It leaves players' fishing logs, but their catches still count toward their total.
eco_fish_name_locked_hint: A built-in species keeps its name: players' catches are tied to it.
eco_fish_rename_hint: Renaming the species also renames past catches: players keep their progress.
eco_fish_enabled_desc: When disabled, it no longer bites and no longer counts toward the log.
eco_fish_rewards_desc: Each player earns a rarity's reward once, after catching every species of that rarity, then the complete-log reward. Players who had already finished a series get it when they open their log.
eco_fish_reward_reset_confirm: Go back to the default reward?
eco_fish_reward_reset_confirm_desc: The server setting for this tier is discarded. Players who already earned it keep what they got.
eco_fish_reward_modal_hint: Leaving everything at zero silences this tier.
eco_fish_reward_clan_points_hint: Paid to the player's clan, or to their in-game guild if the server's teams are guilds. Players without a team receive nothing.
eco_dungeon_desc: A chain of bestiary bosses fought without rest: HP does not recover between floors, loot stays pending until the player leaves, and a defeat loses all of it. A run is played in one go: leaving it ends it, and an hour without fighting counts as a defeat. Bosses disabled in the bestiary can still be used here, which lets you keep some for a dungeon.
eco_dungeon_no_boss: This server's bestiary has no boss. Create one in the Bestiary tab to build a dungeon.
eco_dungeon_broken: A floor points to a boss that no longer exists: the dungeon stays closed to players until it is replaced.
eco_dungeon_chest_hint: Granted to every player who clears the last floor, on top of each boss's XP, coins and loot. This is RPG XP: it levels up the character, not the server level.
eco_dungeon_delete_confirm_desc: Players in the middle of a run leave with the loot they already earned, as if they had left on their own.
eco_dungeon_field_cooldown_hint: Delay between two entries by the same player, counted from their previous entry. 0 for no wait.
eco_dungeon_floors_hint: In the order players face them. The same boss can appear on several floors. Editing floors does not change runs already started.
eco_dungeon_totals: Total boss HP: {health} · strongest boss: lvl {level} · gains for a full run, before randomness, loot and first clear bounty: {xp} RPG XP and {coins} {currency}.
eco_dungeon_enabled_desc: When closed, it disappears from the dungeon hall. Runs already started can still be finished.
eco_hunt_energy_hint: As a percentage of an ordinary fight. 100: same cost, 150: half as much again.
eco_hunt_cd_hint: As a percentage of the fight delay, which also applies to the next fight. 200: doubled delay.
eco_dungeon_first_clear_hint: Bounty granted only once, to the first player on the server who clears the dungeon, on top of the chest. Their win is announced in the bestiary first kill channel, if one is set. Without a bounty, the record is kept with no announcement.
eco_dungeon_first_clear_reset_confirm: Put the first clear bounty back in play?
eco_dungeon_first_clear_reset_confirm_de: The next player to clear the dungeon becomes the first to clear it and receives the bounty. What the previous winner received stays theirs.
api_ok_reset_rpg_dungeon_first_clear: First clear bounty put back in play
eco_gambling_desc: A closed game is refused to everyone, administrators included. /games only lists open games, and closes with the last one. The same setting shows up on the Command access page.
eco_gambling_all_aria: Open or close all gambling games
eco_tower_desc: Roguelite mode: players climb floor by floor with compressed stats, find Tower-only gear and earn shards. Nothing found in the Tower reaches the RPG inventory.
eco_tower_field_description_placeholder: Leave empty for the default text
eco_tower_entry_hint: How RPG stats are converted at the start of each climb. The class and its skills are always kept.
eco_tower_mode_compressed_desc: Each order of magnitude of RPG stats grants the same small bonus (+20%), up to a cap. A veteran starts a little ahead, never far.
eco_tower_mode_reset_desc: Everyone starts with the same base stats. Only the class and the worn title matter.
eco_tower_field_inherit_hint: Cap of the bonus drawn from RPG stats, as a percentage of the Tower base stats.
eco_tower_field_title_cap_hint: Cap of the bonus granted by the worn title.
eco_tower_preview_entry: Starting Tower attack depending on RPG attack
eco_tower_preview_lead: An overpowered player starts with ×{ratio} the stats of a beginner. Gear found in the Tower soon outweighs that gap.
eco_tower_field_growth_hint: Strength monsters gain at each floor. The higher it is, the sooner the wall comes.
eco_tower_field_max_blessings_hint: Beyond that, only blessings already owned can rank up.
eco_tower_field_idle_hint: An idle climb is closed: as a death mid-fight, as a departure otherwise.
eco_tower_field_shards_hint: Earned for each floor climbed, not each room. The value rises every 10 floors and doubles when the floor ends on a defeated guardian.
eco_tower_field_shards_room_hint: On top of the floor's shards, for each room resolved: rewards exploration. 0 to only pay the climbed floor.
eco_tower_field_death_hint: Dying only keeps this share of the climb's shards.
eco_tower_field_cap_hint: Shards each player can earn per week. 0 for no cap.
eco_tower_rewards_desc: What shards buy and what milestones give to the RPG profile: title, role, item, coins, XP, clan points. Prefer cosmetic titles, roles and clan points: a title granting stats, an item or XP make the strongest players even stronger.
eco_tower_reward_delete_confirm_desc: Players who already got it keep it.
eco_tower_leaderboard_empty: Nobody has cleared a floor this season yet.
eco_tower_season_confirm_desc: The leaderboard starts over. Shards, upgrades, bought items and all-time records are kept. Climbs in progress don't count for the new season.
eco_tower_field_repeatable_hint: Can be bought several times (coins only).
eco_tower_reward_power_hint: A title granting stats makes players stronger in the RPG: to keep this mode balance-neutral, prefer a title without bonus.
eco_tower_field_clan_points_hint: Paid to the player's clan, or as XP to their RPG guild if the server's teams are guilds.
eco_tower_field_stat_hint: Added for good to the RPG profile: 1 point is +1 attack, defense or speed, or +8 max HP. "Random" rolls the stat on each purchase. They also slightly strengthen classic climbs, which inherit part of the RPG stats.
eco_tower_field_max_energy_hint: Added for good to the player's max energy, on top of the server's, and filled right away. 0: none.
eco_tower_field_reclass_vouchers_hint: Each voucher pays for a class change instead of coins. The first class choice stays free; 0: none.
eco_tower_field_limit_period_hint: Every day at midnight, or every Monday, in the server time zone. "Never": the limit applies forever.
eco_tower_map_desc: Each map is a floor of the tower: two rooms touching by a side are connected, an empty cell is a wall. On Discord, players explore the floor, beat its guardian and take the stairs to the next floor.
eco_tower_map_hint: Click or drag to paint. The boss is placed as a large 2×2 room from its top-left cell. The number on a room is its distance from the start.
eco_tower_map_need_start: Place an entrance: a start room, wells or entrances to choose.
eco_tower_map_unreachable: {count} room(s) are not connected to the start (dashed red).
eco_tower_map_empty_merchant: A merchant must sell at least one item.
eco_tower_map_too_many: A map holds at most {max} rooms.
eco_tower_map_no_path: No boss reachable from the start.
eco_tower_map_rules: The start can go anywhere: every room connected to it is playable. Rooms already done can be crossed again without a fight. Each room resolved makes monsters a little stronger; beating the guardian climbs one floor.
eco_tower_map_power_tip: Strength always follows depth; this setting multiplies it for this room. The bestiary only gives the creature's profile (sturdy, fast, brutal).
eco_tower_map_power_hint: HP, attack and defense are multiplied on top of the normal climb. Speed is unchanged.
eco_tower_death_map_tip: Colors rooms by how many players died there. Only deaths on this floor as saved count: moving or retyping a room starts over.
eco_tower_map_waves_hint: Back-to-back fights, no healing or fleeing; the last wave is an elite. Power applies to every wave.
eco_tower_map_trial_reward: Pays like a guardian (victory healing and guardian loot chance)
eco_tower_map_trial_reward_tip: Ticked by default, otherwise nobody has a reason to attempt a trial off the main path. Unticked, it only pays for its fights: keep that for a trial on the mandatory path.
eco_tower_map_rotate: Rotate a quarter turn (width and height swap)
eco_tower_map_export_tip: Download this floor as JSON, to import it here or on another server.
eco_tower_map_import_tip: Replace the open floor with an exported JSON file (undo with Ctrl+Z).
eco_tower_export_all_tip: Download every map as JSON, to import them here or on another server.
eco_tower_import_all_tip: Replace every map with a JSON file { floors: [...] }. Nothing is saved until you click Save.
eco_tower_import_all_invalid: Invalid tower file: it needs a list of 1 to {max} maps.
eco_tower_import_all_invalid_card: Invalid tower file: map {card} is not a valid floor.
eco_tower_import_all_confirm: Replace the tower with the {cards} map(s) from the file?
eco_tower_import_all_confirm_desc: The {current} current map(s) will be replaced once the tower is saved. Until then, reloading the page restores them.
eco_tower_map_power_reward: Rewards follow too ({factor} gold and loot chance)
eco_tower_map_power_reward_tip: Unchecked: the room is harder (or easier) without paying more (or less). Handy for a punishing guardian.
eco_tower_map_pipette_tip: Rooms you place copy this one's settings (creature, traits, power...). Alt+click on a room does the same.
