eco_tower_difficulty_power: {count} room(s) with custom power, up to {factor}: ~{hpFrom} to ~{hpTo} HP for a regular monster at that power.
eco_tower_map_shortcuts: Right-click: erase (drag for several) · Shift+drag: fill an area · Alt+click: eyedropper · Delete: remove the selected room · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: undo / redo · Esc: deselect
eco_tower_map_select_hint: Pick the Select tool then click a room to configure it.
eco_clan_tower_short_desc: Every week, the server's clans climb this tower, each on their own.
eco_tower_alert_closed: The Tower is closed: players cannot enter it.
eco_tower_alert_killer: {name} killed {count} players, more than any other monster.
eco_tower_clan_card_desc: A weekly tower where clans compete. Turning it on shows the "Solo Tower / Clan Tower" switch at the top of the page.
eco_tower_clan_card_off: Off: the switch to the Clan Tower is hidden.
eco_tower_clan_card_on: On: use the switch at the top of the page to configure it.
eco_tower_rewards_pick: Pick an item in the list to edit it.
eco_tower_short_desc: The RPG's roguelite mode: players climb floor by floor with compressed stats and earn shards.
eco_clan_tower_desc: Every week, the server's clans climb this tower, each on its own. Everyone enters on equal terms, once a day; the first member of a clan to clear a floor conquers it. Nothing leaves it: no shards, no gear, no record. RPG guilds do not take part.
eco_clan_tower_clans_off: Clans are disabled on this server: the Clan Tower will not open until they are enabled.
eco_clan_tower_off: Disabled: enable it so it opens every week.
eco_clan_tower_no_conquest: No clan has conquered a floor yet.
eco_clan_tower_announce_hint: The opening is announced there. The weekly results go to the clan points feed channel, in a single message.
eco_clan_tower_attempts_hint: One attempt per member per 24 h slice since the opening: 48 hours give two. The hour follows the server's time zone.
eco_clan_tower_per_floor_hint: Paid to the member who conquered the floor for their clan.
eco_clan_tower_points_hint: Paid at closing, under the “RPG - Clan Tower” source. The podium goes to the whole clan; the ranking is by highest floor, then by who got there first.
eco_clan_tower_milestones_hint: Floors climbed in total by a clan's members during the week, everyone's attempts included. Each milestone reached adds its bonus to all of the clan's following attempts. The three milestones must be increasing.
eco_clan_tower_total_tip: Floors climbed in total by the clan's members, and collective milestones reached.
eco_tower_sim_desc: An automatic player runs climbs on your Tower as saved, with the real game engine. It starts with its class's base stats, no RPG inheritance or upgrade (like the daily climb), explores when it has room, drinks below a third of its HP and uses skills as soon as they are ready. The numbers are a ballpark: real players, better geared or smarter, will go further.
eco_tower_sim_skills_tip: The player takes every skill of its class and tree, in their weakened Tower version.
eco_tower_sim_cards_desc: Each variant on its own: “1-A” and “1-B” are two variants of floor 1. The death rate is measured on climbs that reached the map; a variant much deadlier than its siblings needs rebalancing.
eco_tower_cards_real_desc: Climbs that reached each map, variants apart, with their chance of being picked. A redrawn map starts over from zero. Climbs started before this tracking are not included.
eco_tower_sim_capped: {count} climb(s) stopped without dying by the simulation's safeguards (60 floors or too many actions): the Tower may be too easy.
eco_tower_guide_floor: Each floor is a map: first the floors drawn in the Map tab, then generated floors or back to the first one. Players explore the floor, open its exit (guardian, sealed stairs, sealed door or open stairs) and climb. The leaderboard and milestones count floors climbed.
eco_tower_guide_boss: Beating a boss pays 5 times more shards and opens a safe landing: leaving right after keeps every shard. Anywhere else, leaving only keeps a share.
eco_tower_guide_growth: Monster strength only depends on the floor number: two players on the same floor face the same difficulty. Past floor 25, their growth is halved.
eco_tower_guide_combat: In combat: speed gives a chance to dodge (up to 25% at double speed). Elites and bosses announce a heavy blow one turn ahead, which "Defend" parries; a boss under 30% HP flies into a rage. Defending heals a little and strengthens the next attack. Players can flee a fight, except a boss, at the cost of one last hit and 25% of their gold.
eco_tower_modifier_burning: Burning (spreads one room per step, 3% HP per burning room)
eco_tower_modifier_frost: Frozen (first hit of each fight -50%, both sides)
eco_tower_modifier_mist: Mist (fog forced, chests +25% gold, lifts after 8 rooms explored)
eco_tower_modifier_moonless: Moonless night (wanderers twice as fast, ambushes +50%)
eco_tower_modifier_tip: The floor's ambience: it changes how the floor plays without adding rooms.
eco_tower_theme_tip: The floor's look, with no effect on play. Automatic: it follows the height (stone, moss, crypt, ice, forge, arcane, then the abyss). The floor's name doesn't change it.
eco_tower_room_mercenary_tip: An ally for hire: strikes on each of the player's turns until the end of the floor.
eco_tower_room_mentor_tip: Teaches, for gold, one of the RPG skills the player did not buy at the start. One per visit.
eco_tower_room_mimic_tip: Shows up to players as a regular chest. Opening it starts an elite fight with guaranteed loot.
eco_tower_room_trap_tip: Spikes at the entrance (12% HP, never lethal). The player's speed helps avoid them.
eco_tower_map_warp_pair: Portals come in pairs: place both portal A and portal B.
eco_tower_room_warp_tip: Two linked portals: entering one lets you step into the other, wherever it is on the floor. One pair per floor.
eco_tower_generated_fog_hint: Generated floors only show visited rooms and their neighbors. Each drawn floor keeps its own setting, in the Map tab.
eco_tower_category_entry_tip: How players arrive on the floor: a fixed start, wells (random arrival) or entrances to choose. One kind per floor.
eco_tower_category_exits_rule: One exit per floor: placing a new one replaces the old one. Keys go with the sealed stairs, seals with the sealed door.
eco_tower_category_exits_tip: What closes the floor: guardian, sealed stairs, sealed door, open stairs, crumbling stairs or toll, and the door's seals.
eco_tower_category_monsters_tip: Regular fights, elites, trials, mimics, ambushes, wandering monsters and prisoners.
eco_tower_category_other_tip: Chests, campfires, shared springs, shrines, events, traps, portals A and B, and corridors.
eco_tower_map_exit_depth: Exit reachable in {rooms} rooms at the shortest.
eco_tower_map_gate_need_seal: The sealed door needs at least one seal room.
eco_tower_map_key_tip: Beating this elite, opening this chest or clearing this trial gives a key to the sealed stairs.
eco_tower_map_keys_without_stairs: Keys are placed but the exit isn't sealed stairs.
eco_tower_map_need_exit: Place an exit: guardian, sealed stairs, sealed door, open stairs, crumbling stairs or toll.
eco_tower_map_one_exit: A floor has only one exit: remove the extra exits.
eco_tower_map_seals_without_gate: Seals are placed but the exit isn't a sealed door.
eco_tower_map_stairs_need_key: The sealed stairs need at least one key: tick “holds a key” on an elite, a chest or a trial.
eco_tower_room_gate_tip: The floor's exit, opened once every seal room is lit.
eco_tower_room_seal_tip: Guarded by an elite: defeating it lights the seal. Only with a sealed door.
eco_tower_room_stairs_tip: Floor exit, opened once every key on the floor is found. Tick “holds a key” on elites, chests or trials.
eco_tower_room_exit_tip: Floor exit with no condition: no guardian, key or seal. For a transition or resting floor.
eco_tower_category_npc_tip: The floor's characters: merchant, mercenary, mentor, oracle and prisoner.
eco_tower_room_wanderer_tip: Its lair: a stronger-than-average monster that moves one room per player step, within its zone. It only goes through corridors and already cleared fight rooms: never an entrance, exit, NPC or unresolved room.
eco_tower_room_prisoner_tip: A jailer (elite) guards a captive. Defeating it frees the captive, who gives gold, a potion or an ally for the floor.
eco_tower_room_oracle_tip: For gold, reveals the whole floor under fog, or the shortest way to the exit on a floor without fog.
eco_tower_map_wander_hint: In rooms from the lair. In red on the map: the {rooms} cell(s) it can go through (corridors and fight rooms of its zone, once cleared).
eco_tower_room_well_tip: Random entrance: place 2 to 4, the player drops into one of them. The same floor plays differently each time.
eco_tower_room_entrance_tip: Place 2 or 3: on arrival, the player picks one, seeing how many rooms separate it from the exit. A short hard path, a long calm one.
eco_tower_room_ambush_tip: Looks like an empty corridor. The monster hiding there strikes first, then the fight begins.
eco_tower_room_collapse_tip: Exit open as long as the player has not taken too many steps on the floor. After that, it collapses and a guardian blocks the way.
eco_tower_room_toll_tip: Exit paid in coins. Short of gold, or by choice, the player can force the way against an elite, or turn back.
eco_tower_room_fountain_tip: Fountain shared by the whole server: players pour gold into it, and others drink a heal drawn from the pool.
eco_tower_map_entry_mixed: One kind of entrance per floor: a start, wells or entrances to choose, not mixed.
eco_tower_map_wells_count: Place {min} to {max} wells: the player drops into one at random.
eco_tower_map_collapse_hint: Steps taken on the floor, every room counts. The shortest path needs {shortest}: leave some room to explore.
eco_tower_map_toll_hint: Gold earned in the Tower. Too pricey, and players will force the way against an elite.
eco_tower_room_trial_tip: Challenge: several waves of enemies in a row (3 by default, adjustable), the last one an elite, with no way to flee. Can hold a key.
eco_tower_map_status_generated: No floor drawn: players climb automatically generated floors. Draw a floor here so the Tower starts with it.
eco_tower_map_status_then_generated: Players climb your {floors} floor(s) in order, then generated floors. Each floor ends with its exit.
eco_tower_map_status_then_loop: Players climb your {floors} floor(s) in order, then start over from the first, harder. Each floor ends with its exit.
eco_tower_reset_all_confirm_desc: Player data, settings, drawn floors and rewards will be deleted: the Tower starts from scratch. Irreversible.
eco_tower_reset_desc: Erasing player data resets climbs, shards, upgrades, records and milestones earned. Erasing everything also deletes settings, drawn floors and rewards. What was already paid to RPG profiles (coins, XP, items, titles, roles) is kept. Irreversible.
eco_tower_reset_players_confirm_desc: Climbs, shards, upgrades, records and milestones of every player will be deleted. Settings, floors and rewards stay. Irreversible.
eco_tower_guide_depth: Each creature keeps the profile of its bestiary entry (tough, fast, brutal) at equal strength. Elites and guardians carry a trait shown before the fight, guardians a mechanic (shield, summoning, second phase). Relics can have a unique effect, and event rooms offer a risky choice.
eco_tower_announce_hint: When a player beats the server's best floor for the season, the bot announces it here with an image of the tower, without pinging anyone.
eco_tower_daily_board_empty: Nobody has tried today's challenge yet.
eco_tower_daily_desc: Every day, a freshly generated map, the same for the whole server, with equal stats (only class matters) and a single attempt per player. An ambience and a curse are imposed each day, the top 3 receive shards the next day, and playing several days in a row gives a shard bonus. Everything is set by the bot: you only turn it on or off. It has its own leaderboard and counts neither for the season nor for milestones.
eco_tower_difficulty_estimate: Monsters from level {from} to {to} on this floor (regular monster HP: ~{hpFrom} to ~{hpTo}).
eco_tower_difficulty_estimate_tip: Monster strength follows the rooms resolved since the entrance. At the lowest, players rushed straight to each floor's guardian; at the highest, they explored everything. Each creature's traits and profile add to it.
eco_tower_event_blacksmith_tip: Reforges the player's weapon or armor (+15%) for gold.
eco_tower_event_cursed_pact_tip: Lots of gold, but monsters hit 10% harder until the end of the climb.
eco_tower_event_gambler_tip: Double or nothing on half the player's gold.
eco_tower_event_random_tip: A random event rolled when arriving on the floor.
eco_tower_floors_after_generate_desc: The climb continues on new floors, generated in the shape of a tower. Also works with no drawn floor at all.
eco_tower_floors_after_generate_note: After the last drawn floor, the climb continues on generated floors.
eco_tower_floors_after_loop_desc: Drawn floors start over in order, with stronger monsters.
eco_tower_floors_after_loop_note: After the last drawn floor, the climb starts over from the first, harder.
eco_tower_fog_tip: Fog of war on this floor: players only see visited rooms and their neighbors.
eco_tower_fog_forced_tip: The mist forces fog on this floor. Without it, the setting chosen here comes back.
eco_tower_insight_average_tip: Floors climbed on average by finished climbs (daily climb excluded).
eco_tower_insight_deadliest_tip: Floor where the most climbs ended in death.
eco_tower_insight_deaths_tip: Share of finished climbs that ended in death rather than leaving.
eco_tower_insight_killers_tip: Creatures that brought down the most players.
eco_tower_leaderboard_rooms_tip: Rooms explored during the record: they break floor ties.
eco_tower_map_traits_hint: None: rolled at random. Elites and guardians always have one, regular monsters sometimes at high level.
eco_tower_map_traits_tip: Traits show before the fight: they call for a response from the player.
eco_tower_mechanic_none_tip: No mechanic: only heavy blows and rage.
eco_tower_mechanic_phases_tip: At half health, the guardian heals 20% and gains 25% attack and defense, once.
eco_tower_mechanic_random_tip: A random mechanic rolled when arriving on the floor.
eco_tower_mechanic_shield_tip: A shield worth 35% of its HP absorbs the first blows.
eco_tower_mechanic_summoner_tip: Summons a minion every 3 blows (3 at most, +25% damage each). A powerful skill disperses them.
eco_tower_preview_hint: The player arrives at the start: completed rooms get a check mark, the next ones a dotted outline. Randomly rolled traits are only known in game.
eco_tower_preview_tip: See the exact image players will see when arriving on this floor.
eco_tower_room_event_tip: A narrative choice: blood altar, masked gambler, spring, blacksmith or cursed pact.
eco_tower_trait_regenerating_tip: Restores 5% of its HP every turn.
eco_tower_trait_swift_tip: Speed ×1.6: it can dodge the player's blows.
eco_tower_trait_thorny_tip: Returns 15% of the damage it takes.
eco_tower_trait_vampiric_tip: Heals for 30% of the damage it deals.
eco_tower_field_blessing_map_hint: One blessing every N floors climbed, on top of shrines. 0 for shrines only.
eco_tower_field_leave_hint: Leaving off a safe landing only keeps this share. Right after a boss, leaving keeps everything.
eco_tower_field_skill_price_hint: Shards paid at the start to take an RPG skill along for one climb (0: free). The price follows the place in the tree: x1 at the first tier, x1.5 at the second, x2 at the third, x3 at the end. In the Tower they are weakened: bonus damage halved, lifesteal and healing capped, longer cooldown. The daily climb is played without them.
eco_tower_season_reset_milestones: Milestones can be earned again next season
eco_tower_season_reset_milestones_hint: The new season makes milestones earnable again for everyone.
eco_tower_floors_desc: From the ground floor to the top. A map marked “Variant” shares the floor of the map below: one of them is picked at random on each climb. After the last floor, the climb starts over from the first, harder.
eco_tower_floor_variant_tip: This map becomes a variant of the map below: they form a single floor, and one of them is picked at random on each climb.
eco_tower_floor_variant_first: The first map opens the tower: add a map above it to make a variant.
eco_tower_floor_weight_tip: Weight of this map when picking among the variants of its floor: a map of weight 1 against one of weight 9 comes up one time in ten.
eco_tower_floor_next_invalid: Go to the next map to fix
eco_tower_floor_delete_confirm_desc: Its map is erased. Players currently on it finish it normally.
eco_tower_floors_invalid: Fix the flagged floors before saving.
eco_tower_guide_milestones: Milestones trigger on the number of floors cleared during a single climb. Dying or leaving ends the climb and pays out the shards.
eco_tower_guide_start: Drawn floors are played in order, then the climb starts over from the first one with stronger monsters: the tower has no top.
eco_tower_stat_players_tip: Members who have opened the Tower at least once.
eco_tower_stat_runs_tip: Climbs started since opening, all seasons included.
eco_tower_stat_best_tip: Most floors cleared in a single climb this season.
eco_tower_emoji_default_hint: Empty: the bot icon is used instead of an emoji.
eco_tower_upgrades_desc: Bought with shards, they make the player stronger inside the Tower only, on every climb. A disabled upgrade is no longer sold but levels already bought stay active; a deleted upgrade has no effect at all.
eco_tower_upgrades_empty: No upgrade: the shop only sells items.
eco_tower_upgrade_unit_FORTUNE: % gold and item chance per level (30% at most)
eco_tower_upgrade_growth_hint: 100 doubles the price each level, 0 keeps it flat.
eco_tower_upgrade_delete_confirm_desc: Players lose the effect of levels they bought, with no refund. To only stop selling it, disable it.
eco_tower_items_desc: Rewards paid to the RPG profile for shards: title, role, item, coins, XP, clan points.
eco_tower_merchant_desc: The merchant sells for the gold earned during the climb, lost on exit. An item costs its base price plus the increase times the floor. On a map, each merchant room picks its items and scales these prices by a percentage.
eco_tower_merchant_offers_hint: On a map, each merchant room picks its own.
eco_tower_merchant_potion_tip: One more potion in the bag (5 at most).
eco_tower_merchant_heal_tip: Instantly restores part of max HP.
eco_tower_merchant_gear_tip: A piece of gear rolled for the floor, rarer than from a fight.
eco_tower_merchant_potion_heal_hint: Applies to every potion: starting, found or bought.
eco_tower_room_start_tip: Where players arrive on the floor, at the foot of the stairs. Exactly one per map, anywhere you like.
eco_tower_room_monster_tip: A fight against a monster of the floor: gold and sometimes an item. Counts as a floor once won.
eco_tower_room_elite_tip: A tougher monster, guaranteed item. Counts as a floor once won.
eco_tower_room_boss_tip: Large 2×2 room. Beating it pays 5 times more shards and climbs to the next floor.
eco_tower_room_chest_tip: Gold, an item or both, no fight. Counts as a floor.
eco_tower_room_campfire_tip: Restores part of max HP. Counts as a floor.
eco_tower_room_merchant_tip: Spend the climb's gold. Counts as a floor when the player leaves.
eco_tower_room_shrine_tip: One blessing to pick out of three. Counts as a floor.
eco_tower_room_empty_tip: A plain passage: triggers nothing and doesn't count as a floor.
eco_tower_map_tool_select_tip: Click a room to set its creature, contents or prices.
eco_tower_map_tool_erase_tip: Click or drag to remove rooms. Right-click also erases, whatever the tool.
eco_tower_map_unreachable_tip: Not connected to the start: the player can never get there.
anx_section_overview_desc: The essentials of the period at a glance, compared with the previous period.
anx_section_activity_desc: Messages, voice, busiest channels, peak hours and commands used.
anx_section_content_desc: What members post: message types, emojis, stickers, GIFs, linked sites and formatting.
anx_section_channels_desc: Each category with its channels, text and voice together. Open a category to see it in detail.
anx_section_members_desc: Who keeps the server alive, who talks to whom, and who went quiet.
anx_section_growth_desc: Joins, leaves, cohort retention and churn risk.
anx_section_moderation_desc: Sanctions, recurring reasons and most sanctioned members.
anx_filter_bots_hint: Bots never post in activity stats. This box only changes the member count.
anx_filter_period_only: This section only follows the period: channel, role and staff filters don't apply here.
anx_period_only_note: Follows the period, not the channel, role and staff filters.
anx_kpi_active_members_hint: Members who wrote or spoke in voice at least once during the period.
anx_voice_unavailable: Voice can't be filtered by channel and role at once: only messages are shown.
anx_backfill_desc: Kotbo is reading already logged messages: {processed} of {total}. Numbers will keep going up.
anx_content_rank_basis_channel: Rankings (emojis, stickers, sites) follow the selected channel; the role or staff filter doesn't apply to them.
anx_content_empty_desc: Content stats start with new messages. Come back after some activity on the server.
anx_content_kpi_reaction_hint: Messages that got at least one reaction, counted on the day they were posted.
anx_types_desc: {count} messages. Each counts once, under its main type: an image with text is an image.
anx_emojis_desc: Default Discord emojis, this server's emojis and emojis from other servers.
anx_emoji_servers_desc: Source server when Discord or Kotbo knows it. The rest is grouped as "unknown server".
anx_emoji_servers_empty: No external emojis in this period.
anx_stickers_desc: This server's stickers, stickers from other servers and official Discord stickers.
anx_gif_desc: {share} of messages. Source detected from the link or the uploaded file.
anx_sites_desc: Domain only, never the full link.
anx_markdown_desc: {share} of messages are formatted. Share of those messages using each style; a message can use several.
anx_channels_desc: Click a category for its detailed view, a channel for its card.
anx_channels_orphan: {count} messages come from archived threads or deleted channels: they count in the total, not in the table.
anx_col_authors_hint: Members who wrote in the channel. For a category, sum of its channels: a member active in two channels counts twice.
anx_category_active_hint: Members who wrote or spoke in voice in this category during the period.
anx_category_share_hint: Share of the server's messages. In voice: {voice}.
anx_category_voice_history: Per-member voice detail is only kept for {days} days: beyond that, only messages count towards active members.
anx_category_daily_desc: Text and voice together: each member counts once per day.
anx_category_no_text: No text channel in this category.
anx_category_no_members: Nobody was active here during the period.
anx_member_content_desc: What this member posts: message types, emojis, reactions and sites.
anx_member_content_empty: No analysed messages for this member
an_wk_progress_hint: A positive trend means an engaged community.
an_wk_subtitle: Compare activity across several weeks or months
anx_filter_own_window: This sub-tab uses its own time window: the period and filters don't apply here.
anx_kpi_peak_voice_hint: Highest number of members in voice at the same time during the period.
anx_algo_empty_desc: The daily algo didn't run during this period.
anx_emojis_kpi_servers_hint: Identified servers the ranked external emojis come from.
anx_sites_kpi_type_hint: Messages whose main content is the link (no image or video attached).
anx_live_desc: Server state right now, bots excluded.
anx_growth_retention_hint: Share of members who joined during the period and are still here.
anx_growth_inviters_desc: Members whose invites were used the most.
anx_growth_inviters_empty: No tracked invites in this period.
anx_roles_desc: Number of members holding each role.
anx_mod_active_hint: Sanctions still active today, whatever their date.
anx_mod_moderators_hint: Staff members who sanctioned during the period.
anx_forecast_month: At this pace: about {value} by the end of the month.
anx_forecast_unavailable: Forecasts need 28 days of history, at daily step, over a period ending today.
anx_hourly_unavailable: Hourly steps only exist for the whole server, over 14 days at most. The chart stays daily.
anx_breakdown_unavailable: The per-channel breakdown doesn't apply with this filter.
anx_breakdown_empty: Nothing to break down over this period.
anx_note_hint: Visible to everyone on the team with Analytics access. Tip: click a point on the chart to pick its date.
anx_top_unavailable: This ranking doesn't apply with the chosen filters: voice isn't tracked per channel and per member at once.
anx_metric_active_hint: Members who wrote or spoke in voice, averaged per day. The tile shows the distinct total for the period.
anx_metric_per_active_hint: Messages of the day divided by that day's active members.
anx_metric_net_joins_hint: Joins minus leaves, for the whole server.
anx_metric_voice_per_active_hint: Voice minutes of the day divided by that day's active members.
demo_tour_home_body: Pending tickets, absences to approve, upcoming meetings: the home page lists what the staff has to handle. Each line leads to the right page.
demo_tour_sanctions_body: Who sanctioned, why, and for how long: it's all on record. Sort and filter the list to find a member.
demo_tour_automod_title: Anti-spam comes down to two numbers
demo_tour_automod_body: How many messages, in how many seconds, and what happens next. Change a threshold, then save with the bar at the bottom of the screen.
demo_tour_tickets_body: Open a ticket: read the thread, reply, claim it or close it. On a real server, the member gets your reply in their ticket channel.
demo_tour_leveling_body: Members earn XP by chatting and in voice, and levels can grant roles. The earning rules live in the other tabs.
demo_tour_end_body: Whatever you change stays in your browser. The buttons on the right reset the demo or add Kotbo to your server.
demo_tour_staff_title: Your staff, run like a team
demo_tour_staff_body: Directory, ranks, hierarchies, internal warnings, polls: everything about your moderation team fits on one page.
demo_page_home_stats_body: Members, people online, people in voice, and this week's joins and leaves.
demo_page_home_chart_body: Messages, voice, joins, leaves or sanctions: the block's menu switches the chart.
demo_page_home_edit_body: This button turns on edit mode: move blocks, resize them, add or remove modules.
demo_page_sanctions_tabs_body: The Settings tab holds progressive scales: each repeat offence moves the sanction up one step.
demo_page_sanctions_search_body: Search by type, sanctioned member, moderator or reason.
demo_page_sanctions_columns_body: Every column sorts, and the funnel filters by type, member, moderator or status.
demo_page_sanctions_row_body: The moderator who issued the sanction can attach a report. Delete removes it from the history.
demo_page_automod_tabs_body: Bot filters, Discord's native AutoMod, anti-bot and admin locks, behavioural anti-spam, exceptions.
demo_page_automod_threshold_body: How many messages are allowed in the interval. Past that, the filter fires.
demo_page_automod_action_body: What Kotbo does once the threshold is crossed: warn, time out…
demo_page_automod_more_body: Emojis, mentions, ghost pings, @everyone: each filter is switched on and tuned on its own.
demo_page_staff_stats_body: Staff members, configured roles, active internal warnings, open polls.
demo_page_staff_tabs_body: Roles, org chart, internal warnings, blacklist, polls, leadership and dashboard permissions.
demo_page_staff_actions_body: Tutor, hierarchy ranks, promotion, demotion, suspension, removal: all from their row.
demo_page_staff_add_body: Add a server member to the staff and pick their rank.
demo_page_tickets_filters_body: Pending, open, claimed, closed, archived: one click shows a single queue.
demo_page_tickets_item_body: Click it to open the conversation.
demo_page_tickets_chat_body: Read the member's messages and reply. The buttons at the top claim, rename or close the ticket.
demo_page_tickets_tabs_body: Transcripts of closed tickets, satisfaction ratings, staff canned replies, blacklist and settings.
demo_page_leveling_tabs_body: XP gains, progression curve, level-up announcements, leaderboard and import of existing levels.
demo_page_leveling_stats_body: Ranked members, highest level, average level and total XP earned.
demo_page_leveling_podium_body: The server's top three, with their level and XP.
demo_page_leveling_search_body: Type a username to see their rank and level.
demo_page_leveling_presets_body: Each preset sets XP per message, the delay between gains and the curve at once. The card shows what it means at level 10.
demo_page_leveling_announce_body: The channel where Kotbo announces every level-up.
demo_page_leveling_advanced_body: Voice XP, daily cap, role multipliers, rewards: all the detail sits behind this button.
anx_channel_filter_ignored: The channel filter doesn't apply here: these figures aren't tracked per channel. Role and staff exclusion still apply.
anx_eng_dau_hint: Members who wrote or spoke in voice that day (DAU).
anx_eng_wau_hint: Members active at least once over the trailing 7 days (WAU).
anx_eng_mau_hint: Members active at least once over the trailing 30 days (MAU).
anx_eng_stickiness_hint: Daily actives divided by monthly actives (DAU/MAU): the share of regulars who come back each day.
anx_eng_verdict_high: Very good: a large share of the month's active members come back nearly every day.
anx_eng_verdict_mid: Fair: your active members drop by several times a week. Regular events or daily quests help push it up.
anx_eng_verdict_low: Low: many members drop by once and disappear. Check the onboarding funnel and declining members.
anx_eng_weekly_points: Over a long period, one point per week.
anx_seg_desc: Members present on {date} ({total}), by their active days.
anx_seg_regular_hint: Active at least 8 days out of the last 28.
anx_seg_casual_hint: Active 1 to 7 days out of the last 28.
anx_seg_reactivated_hint: Came back in the last 14 days after at least 4 weeks of silence.
anx_seg_declining_hint: At least half as many active days as the month before: the first ones to reach out to.
anx_seg_dormant_hint: No activity for 28 days, but active within the last six months.
anx_seg_silent_hint: No activity for six months (or ever).
anx_seg_days_hint: Active days: previous 28 days → last 28 days
anx_cohort_desc: Share of each joining week still active S weeks later (writing or speaking counts, just being there doesn't).
anx_funnel_desc: Members who joined during the period.
anx_funnel_stayed_hint: Still here, or left more than 7 days after joining.
anx_funnel_first_hint: Wrote at least one message after joining.
anx_funnel_eligible: Out of the {count} members who joined long enough ago to tell.
anx_funnel_sources_desc: Which link brings members who stay and take part. Labels are set on the Invites page.
anx_funnel_empty: No one joined during this period.
anx_resp_median_hint: Half of the turns get an answer faster than this. Estimated from delay brackets.
anx_resp_unanswered_hint: Turns no other member followed up within 6 hours.
anx_resp_turns_hint: A member speaking up; their back-to-back messages count as one.
anx_resp_user_ignored: The role filter and staff exclusion don't apply to response time: it's measured per channel, all members combined.
anx_resp_empty_desc: Response time is measured since the update (and in the history when message logging is on). Check back in a few days.
anx_conc_top1_hint: Share of activity made by the most active 1% of members (at least one person).
anx_conc_half_hint: Number of members who alone make half the activity. The higher, the better spread.
anx_conc_gini_hint: 0: everyone takes part equally; 1: one person does everything.
anx_conc_lorenz_desc: Cumulative share of activity by share of the {members} active members, from least to most active.
anx_conc_verdict_high: Very concentrated: the server relies on a handful of members. If one leaves, activity drops. Consider featuring other members (roles, events, dedicated channels).
anx_conc_verdict_mid: Concentrated, like most communities: an active core carries most of it, the rest joins in now and then.
anx_conc_verdict_low: Well spread: many members take part, the server doesn't depend on a few people.
anx_ch_desc: Most fragile first. The score blends volume, number of authors, responsiveness and trend.
anx_ch_suggest_archive: Archiving or hiding it lightens the channel list.
anx_ch_suggest_revive: Revive it: a pinned topic, a question, an event.
anx_ch_suggest_split: Split it into topic channels so conversations don't step on each other.
anx_ch_suggest_merge: Merge it with a related channel.
anx_net_members_hint: Members who replied to or mentioned someone, or got a reply or mention.
anx_net_reciprocity_hint: Share of links where both members reply to or mention each other.
anx_net_isolated_hint: Members who write but exchange with nobody (no reply, no mention).
anx_net_empty_desc: Replies and mentions between members are counted since the update (and in the history if message logging is on).
anx_net_groups_desc: Members who mostly talk among themselves. Names shown are the group's most connected.
anx_net_groups_empty: No group of at least three members.
anx_net_bridges_desc: They connect several groups: valuable for the server's cohesion.
anx_net_bridges_empty: No member really connects several groups.
anx_net_pairs_desc: A reply weighs twice as much as a mention.
anx_net_isolated_desc: They write without exchanging: a welcome, a reply or a role can make them stay.
anx_net_isolated_empty: Every active member exchanges with someone.
anx_growth_quick_leave_hint: Share of the period's newcomers who left the same day: often an unclear welcome, poorly targeted ads or bots.
anx_growth_sources_desc: Day by day, the top five sources. Labels are set on the Invites page.
anx_growth_tenure_desc: How long the members who left during the period had been around.
anx_growth_tenure_unknown: {count} leave(s) with no known join date.
anx_modt_recidivism_hint: Share of members sanctioned at least twice during the period.
anx_modt_delay_hint: Median over {count} sanction report(s) linked to a sanction.
anx_modt_moderators_desc: Who carries moderation, and with which sanction types.
anx_modt_offenders_desc: Members sanctioned several times during the period.
anx_staff_first_hint: Median delay between opening and the first message from someone other than the author.
anx_staff_not_measured: First response is measured since the update: older tickets have no delay.
anx_staff_load_desc: Tickets claimed, closed, and median delay of their first responses.
anx_staff_load_empty: No ticket handled during the period.
anx_staff_coverage_desc: Tickets opened by day and hour ({tz}). The darker the cell, the longer the first response took; the dot grows with the number of tickets.
anx_staff_slow_hours: Slowest slots: {hours}. A staff member on duty at those times would shorten the wait.
anx_words_rising_desc: Words taking up more room than in the previous period.
anx_words_no_data: Not enough words counted over this period yet.
anx_words_disabled: Word tracking is off. Turn it on in Analytics settings (anonymous counting, no message kept).
anx_live_denied: Live isn't available with your rights on this server.
anx_live_bars_label: {total} messages over the last 30 minutes, minute by minute
anx_live_partial: Counted since {time} (bot restart): the window isn't full yet.
anx_section_automation_desc: Get notified when something moves, and receive the summary without opening the dashboard.
anx_alert_desc: Checked every 5 minutes. A triggered alert then stays quiet for its cooldown.
anx_alert_empty: No alerts. Example: "let me know if messages drop 30% over a day".
anx_alert_m_channel_rate: Messages per hour in a channel
anx_alert_f_cooldown_hint: Avoids getting the same alert over and over.
anx_alert_err_recipients: Pick a channel or at least one member to notify by DM.
anx_rcpt_users_hint: 10 people at most. A member with closed DMs won't receive anything.
anx_rep_desc: A summary sent at server time: the past week or month, compared with the previous period.
anx_rep_monthly_when: on day {day} of each month at {hour}:00
anx_rep_tz_note: The time follows the server's configured timezone.
anx_cmp_desc: Two or three roles or channels over the chosen period, or the chosen period against another one.
anx_cmp_period_a_hint: Period A is the one in the filter bar; pick period B to compare.
anx_cmp_need_period: Pick the dates of period B.
anx_cmp_diff_hint: Page filters (staff excluded, bots) apply to each segment.
anx_views_empty: Save the current tab, period and filters to come back in one click.
anx_mem_peak_online_hint: Highest number of members online at once, day by day. The tile shows the average of those peaks.
anx_mem_sources_desc: {count} joins with a known source. The percentage is the share still here.
anx_mem_quality_desc: Members who joined during the period.
anx_mem_young_hint: Share of newcomers whose Discord account was under 7 days old: a high share may signal a raid or throwaway accounts.
anx_mem_onboarding_hint: Share of newcomers who completed Discord's onboarding screen (rules, questions).
anx_mem_links_desc: Joins per invite link and share still here.
anx_mem_links_empty: No tracked link join during the period.
anx_mem_inviters_desc: Members whose links brought the most people, and how many stayed.
anx_hm_desc: Average per slot over the period, {tz} time.
anx_hm_week_total_hint: Sum of the averages of the 168 slots: the volume of an ordinary week over the period.
anx_hm_weekend_hint: Share of activity on Saturday and Sunday (29% if spread evenly).
anx_hm_advice: Busiest slots: {slots}. That's when an announcement or event will reach the most people.
anx_hm_vs_previous: Typical week volume: {change} vs the previous period.
anx_pc_to_date_hint: Compares the same elapsed days on both sides.
anx_pc_to_date_desc: The reference stops at the same elapsed day ({end}).
anx_pc_full_desc: The current period isn't over: a drop may come from the days left.
anx_pc_active_hint: Distinct members who wrote or spoke, compared to date.
anx_cmd_error_rate_hint: Commands that failed (bot or Discord error).
anx_cmd_empty_desc: Commands are counted per day since the update.
anx_cmd_all_time_desc: Old counter, undated: it doesn't follow the chosen period.
anx_cmd_table_desc: Subcommands listed separately. Click a header to sort.
anx_cmd_top_users_desc: Members who run the most commands.
anx_cmd_unused_desc: Used in the previous period, not at all in this one.
owh_page_desc: Send your server's events, signed, to your CRM, spreadsheet, n8n or your own backend.
owh_events_all_future: All events, including those added later.
owh_form_https_required: The URL must start with https://.
owh_rotate_desc: The old secret stops working immediately: remember to update your integration.
owh_delete_desc: Pending deliveries and this webhook's log will be erased.
owh_cut_hint: Check that your server answers with a 2xx code, then re-enable it.
owh_failing_hint: Deliveries are retried automatically. After {limit} consecutive failures, the webhook is disabled.
owh_secret_desc: Used to verify that each delivery really comes from Kotbo.
owh_log_desc: Every attempt, with request and response. Kept for {days} days.
owh_log_empty_desc: Send a test or wait for the next event.
owh_empty_desc: Connect Kotbo to any tool: every join, sanction or ticket can be sent there in real time.
owh_howto_desc: Each request is a JSON POST signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the webhook's secret.
owh_header_event_id: Stable event ID, use it to deduplicate
owh_retry_rule_2xx: A delivery succeeds when your server answers 2xx within 10 seconds. Redirects are not followed.
owh_retry_rule_schedule: Otherwise it is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 12 h and 24 h: {attempts} attempts in total.
owh_retry_rule_cut: After 40 failures in a row, the webhook disables itself. Re-enable it in one click.
owh_retry_rule_dedupe: The same event may arrive twice: deduplicate with Kotbo-Event-Id.
owh_form_name_hint: To find it again, for example the tool's name.
owh_form_url_hint: Public HTTPS only. Internal addresses are refused.
owh_form_all_hint: Including events added to Kotbo later.
owh_secret_new_hint: Copy this secret now and store it in your integration. You can reveal it again, but every reveal is logged.
sim_setup_desc: Replay a rule on past messages without sanctioning anyone.
sim_keywords_hint: One per line. "word" = whole word, "word*" = starts with, "*word" = ends with, "*word*" = anywhere.
sim_allowlist_hint: Passages that never trigger the rule, same syntax.
sim_links_whitelist_hint: One per line, for example your partner server's invite.
sim_limit_hint: The rule triggers above this value.
sim_regex_hint: Case-insensitive. 300 characters max, no nested quantifiers.
sim_scam_whitelist_hint: Taken from scam protection, editable here for the test.
sim_everyone_hint: Matches any message that mentions @everyone or @here.
sim_compare_hint: Shows what your changes add or remove.
sim_compare_unavailable: This rule isn't active today: nothing to compare.
sim_apply: Apply these settings to the page
sim_empty_desc: Pick a rule and run the simulation: you'll see which messages it would have hit, from whom and in which channels.
sim_diff_body: {added} more message(s) would be hit, {removed} would no longer be. The current version hits {current}.
sim_approximate: Estimate: history keeps neither role mentions, nor the permission to mention @everyone, nor messages the bot deleted mid-spam.
sim_truncated: Only the {count} most recent messages were scanned.
sim_coverage: Stored history only goes back to {date}.
sim_samples_desc: Most recent first, triggering passage highlighted.
sim_no_match_desc: Over this period, the rule wouldn't have blocked anything.
mp_not_found_desc: No trace of this member on the server.
mp_activity_desc: Messages per day over {days} days, dot under the bar on voice days.
mp_activity_empty: No activity recorded over the period.
mp_timeline_desc: Everything about this member, most recent first.
th_empty_desc: Switch queue or search to see others.
th_sla_section_desc: First reply and resolution times, tracked in the inbox.
th_sla_first_hint: For example 60: a ticket without a reply after an hour becomes "overdue".
th_stats_intro: Median times, with the 90th percentile to spot forgotten tickets.
th_backlog_callout: {unassigned} ticket(s) without an owner and {waiting} waiting for a staff reply.
th_volume_desc: When closures stay below openings, the queue grows.
th_agents_desc: Tickets handled over the period, median times and satisfaction.
th_agents_empty_desc: Staff members show up as soon as they take a ticket.
wx_intro: Try several welcome messages at once: each newcomer gets a random version, and Kotbo compares who stays and who starts talking.
wx_welcome_off: The welcome message is disabled or has no channel: a test won't change anything until it's set up in the Welcome tab.
wx_empty_desc: Compare your current message with a warmer one, a shorter one, with or without a welcome card: the numbers will decide.
wx_start_desc: Each newcomer will get one of the versions at random. Versions can't be edited afterwards.
wx_stop_desc: Newcomers will get the configured message again. Results stay available.
wx_delete_desc: The test and its results will be erased.
wx_ship_desc: This version becomes the server's welcome for everyone, and the test stops.
wx_results_desc: A newcomer only counts for a metric once its delay has passed.
wx_rec_winner_body: {uplift} on "{metric}", with a {chance} chance of beating the current message.
wx_rec_control_title: The current message is still best
wx_rec_control_body: No version does better on "{metric}". You can stop the test.
wx_rec_none_body: With this many newcomers, the gap is too small to matter. Keep the version you prefer.
wx_rec_collecting_body: {current} newcomer(s) measured per version on "{metric}"; about {needed} are needed to detect a 20% difference.
wx_rec_collecting_early: At least 30 measured newcomers per version are needed first on "{metric}".
wx_method_note: The chance to beat control is computed as in Bayesian experimentation tools; a version is declared the winner above 95% with at least 30 measured newcomers per version.
wx_field_metric_hint: The one that picks the winner.
wx_field_hypothesis_hint: What you expect to see, to remember it in a month.
wx_field_hypothesis_ph: A shorter message will keep more people in the first week.
wx_field_message_control_ph: Empty: the current message from the Welcome tab.
tn_section_desc: Tells the member, before their ticket is created, that the conversation will be recorded, transcribed and archived.
tn_enable: Show the notice before every ticket
tn_enable_desc: The member reads it in a message only they can see; the ticket is created once the delay has passed.
tn_seconds_hint: Between 5 and 30 seconds. 10 to 15 leave time to read.
tn_text_ph: Empty: default text (recording, transcript on close, archiving, training and service quality).
tn_text_hint: The countdown is added automatically below the text.
tn_default_text:
This ticket will be recorded: the messages exchanged are kept.

When it is closed, a full transcript is generated and archived.

These records are used for team training and service quality. Only authorised staff can access them.
tn_preview_countdown: Your ticket will be created in {seconds} seconds.
tr_approved: Request approved: the ticket is open and the member notified.
tr_rejected: Request rejected: the member was notified by DM.
tr_reject_desc: The member receives the rejection by DM, with the reason if there is one.
tr_reject_reason_ph: E.g. already handled, not enough information…
aegis_subtitle: Spots insults and measures the tone of conversations with AegisAI, the AI built by marvideo.
aegis_status_off: No API key on this bot
aegis_disabled_desc: Once on, every message is scored by AegisAI within seconds: the worst ones are removed, borderline cases are sent to you, and the server's tone shows up in Analytics.
aegis_off_api: This bot has no AegisAI key: the Kotbo administrator needs to set AEGISAI_API_KEY.
aegis_sensitivity_desc: The toxicity score goes from 0 to 100. Below the first threshold nothing happens; between the two, staff decides; above the second, the bot acts on its own.
aegis_review_threshold_hint: From this score, the message is sent to you.
aegis_auto_threshold_hint: From this score, the bot removes the message on its own.
aegis_threshold_error: The automatic action threshold must be above the review threshold.
aegis_test_desc: See how AegisAI scores a message with the thresholds above. It is only shared for training if you allowed it under Privacy.
aegis_test_result_none: This message would go through without triggering anything.
aegis_test_result_review: This message would be sent to staff.
aegis_test_result_auto: This message would be removed automatically.
aegis_action_title: When the bot acts on its own
aegis_action_desc: What happens above the automatic action threshold. A message scored late is sent for review instead of being removed.
aegis_warn_weight_hint: On the weighted warning scale: 1 light, 2 normal, 3 serious.
aegis_notify_member_desc: A short message in the channel, deleted after a few seconds.
aegis_review_channel_hint: Where messages to review and the bot's actions are posted. Empty: the log channel.
aegis_scope_desc: Every message is scored, staff and administrators included. For them and for exemptions, the bot never acts on its own: above the threshold, the message is sent to you.
aegis_edits_desc: Catches insults added afterwards to get around the filter.
aegis_nicknames_desc: A nickname judged toxic is replaced with a neutral one.
aegis_tickets_desc: Shows the requester's mood on each ticket.
aegis_ticket_boost: High priority on anger or distress
aegis_ticket_boost_desc: A low or normal priority ticket is raised to high.
aegis_exempt_desc: Their messages are scored, but never removed or sanctioned automatically: above the threshold, they go to review. Administrators are handled the same way. Added to AutoMod's exemptions.
aegis_privacy_sent: Sent to AegisAI: message text, without mentions, links or emojis. Never attachments or member identities.
aegis_privacy_kept: Kept by Kotbo: hourly counters per channel, and excerpts of flagged messages, erased when the log retention period ends.
aegis_training_desc: Analyzed messages join AegisAI's training set to improve its detection.
aegis_consent_intro: To score a message, Kotbo sends it to AegisAI. You can also let AegisAI keep it to improve its model.
aegis_consent_yes_desc: Yes: analyzed messages join AegisAI's training set.
aegis_consent_no_desc: No: they are scored, then forgotten.
aegis_consent_note: You can change your mind under Privacy.
aegis_conflict_desc: When things heat up between several members in a channel, the bot sets a temporary slowmode and alerts staff.
aegis_harassment_desc: A member who sends several toxic messages to the same person, as replies or mentions, is reported along with those messages.
aegis_distress_desc: A message with strong sadness or fear is quietly flagged to staff. Never any sanction.
aegis_distress_channel_hint: A restricted channel ideally. Empty: the card channel.
aegis_distress_note: AegisAI sometimes mistakes disgust for sadness: these alerts are a prompt to check in, not a conclusion.
aegis_review_desc: Confirm to apply the sanction, or mark a false positive to undo what the bot did.
aegis_fallback: Caught by the banned word list (AegisAI unavailable)
aegis_empty_pending_desc: Borderline messages will show up here.
aegis_decided_dismiss: False positive saved, the bot's action is undone.
anx_section_climate_desc: Toxicity and emotions in conversations, by Kotbo × AegisAI.
aegis_climate_off_desc: Turn it on in Security → Filters → AI to measure the server's tone.
aegis_climate_empty_desc: The first figures arrive a few minutes after activation. Collection follows the server's Analytics setting.
aegis_metric_toxic_rate_hint: Share of messages above the review threshold.
aegis_metric_false_positive_hint: Share of decisions overturned by staff.
aegis_emotions_desc: Emotion breakdown of analyzed messages, excluding neutral.
aegis_heatmap_desc: Toxic message rate by day and hour, in your local time.
aegis_channels_desc: Channels where things are most heated.
aegis_members_desc: Members with the most messages above the review threshold.
aegis_members_empty: No member above the review threshold over the period.
aegis_detections_desc: What the module flagged over the period, and what staff did about it.
aegis_member_desc: Toxicity and emotions of their messages over 30 days (Kotbo × AegisAI).
aegis_member_none: No message analyzed over the period.
aegis_test_shared: Shared with AegisAI for training (Privacy: yes).
mcp_perm_read_site_desc: Settings, pages and their content, history, comments and traffic of the community website.
mcp_perm_write_site_desc: Create and configure the website, write and publish pages, manage the menu and comments. The agent locks editing while it works, and can be stopped from the dashboard or the website.
mod_site_desc: The server's public site at /s/<address>: pages, theme, menu and module blocks.
mod_site_wiki_desc: The site's knowledge base: page tree, tags, history, search and the /wiki command.
mod_site_blog_desc: Dated articles on the site, with member comments and an RSS feed.
ste_page_desc: Pages, wiki, blog and look of the public site.
ste_no_site_desc: Only the server's managers can create the site.
ste_module_off_desc: The site stays offline while the Community site module is off. You can keep preparing your pages.
ste_suspended_title: Site suspended by the Kotbo team
ste_suspended_desc: The site is no longer available to the public. Contact Kotbo support to learn more.
ste_create_desc: Pick an address and a starting point. You can change everything later.
ste_create_note: The site starts offline, with sample pages based on your modules.
ste_site_online_desc: Anyone can read the public pages.
ste_site_offline_desc: Only staff can see the site. Visitors get a holding page.
ste_overview_resume: Pick up where you left off
ste_overview_resume_desc: Drafts and changes not published yet.
ste_profile_title: My card on the Staff page
ste_profile_desc: What visitors see about you on the Staff page.
ste_profile_bio_hint: A few words about your role, up to 400 characters.
ste_profile_hidden: Don't show me on the Staff page
ste_pages_desc: The site's free-form pages: home, rules, recruitment, about…
ste_wiki_desc: A knowledge base organised as a tree, with tags and history.
ste_blog_desc: Dated articles, with comments and an RSS feed.
ste_pages_empty_desc: Create a first page to get started.
ste_delete_page_confirm: "{title}" and its history will be deleted. Its subpages move up one level.
ste_theme_desc: Every theme has a light and a dark version.
ste_branding_desc: Taken from Discord by default. You can replace them with your own images.
ste_custom_css_desc: Applied to the site content, after the theme.
ste_custom_css_rules: No external imports or fixed positioning. Images must come from the site's images.
ste_nav_desc: Links shown in the menu, with one level of submenu.
ste_nav_empty_desc: Without a menu, the site lists its published pages in list order.
ste_comments_desc: Comments held by moderation wait for your decision.
ste_visitors_hint: Estimated without cookies, once per day and device.
ste_analytics_section_desc: Community site traffic, measured without cookies.
ste_site_name_hint: Leave empty to use the server's name.
ste_tagline_hint: One sentence under the name, also used in link previews.
ste_slug_redirect_note: The old address will redirect to the new one.
ste_slug_change_confirm: The site will move from /s/{old} to /s/{next}. Old links will redirect to the new address.
ste_staff_page_desc: What each card shows. Every staff member can hide themselves.
ste_editors_desc: These roles can write without dashboard access, from My space.
ste_announces_desc: The bot posts a message in the chosen channel each time something is published.
ste_delete_site_desc: Deletes the site, its pages, history, images and statistics. This can't be undone.
ste_delete_site_confirm: All pages, images and statistics will be lost.
ste_space_desc: The wikis and blogs your roles let you write in.
ste_editor_load_error: It may have been deleted, or you don't have permission to edit it.
ste_history_desc: A version is kept on every publish, up to 100.
ste_restore_confirm: The current draft will be replaced. Nothing changes online until the next publish.
ste_preview_copied: Preview link copied, valid for 7 days
ste_unpublish_confirm: It will no longer be visible on the site. The draft is kept.
ste_schedule_desc: The page will be published automatically at this time.
ste_excerpt_hint: Shown in search results and link previews.
ste_excerpt_hint_blog: Shown in the article list and the RSS feed.
ste_icon_hint: An emoji, shown in the menu and the wiki index.
ste_seo_title_hint: Leave empty to use the page title.
ste_seo_description_hint: Leave empty to use the summary.
ste_agent_active_title: An MCP agent is editing the site ({key}), editing is locked
ste_agent_interrupted: Agent interrupted by {name}. It can't edit the site again before {time}.
ste_agent_allowed_toast: The agent can edit the site again
ste_placeholder: Write, or type / to insert a block
ste_collab_unavailable: Live collaboration is unavailable, you're editing alone for now.
ste_item_heading_desc: Listed in the table of contents.
ste_item_callout_desc: A note, a tip or a warning.
ste_item_bento_desc: A grid of cells in mixed sizes.
ste_block_unavailable: Module turned off on the server, the block stays hidden on the site.
ste_block_staff_desc: Staff by hierarchy, with bio and seniority.
ste_block_rules_desc: The rules published with the Rules module.
ste_block_news_desc: The latest posts from the News module.
ste_block_serverStats_desc: Members, online members and creation date.
ste_block_appeal_desc: The appeal form for banned members.
ste_block_form_desc: A custom form to fill in on the site.
ste_block_ticket_desc: Open a ticket from the site, also followed on Discord.
ste_block_leaderboard_desc: XP, prestige, reputation, season or economy.
ste_block_seasons_desc: The current season and past winners.
ste_block_profile_desc: Level, rank and stats of the signed-in member.
ste_block_wikiIndex_desc: The wiki tree, whole or from a given page.
ste_block_search_desc: A search box for the whole site.
ste_block_channelFeed_desc: The latest messages from a public channel.
ste_cfg_allow_submit: Let visitors suggest an idea from the site
ste_cfg_tag_hint: Leave empty to show every article.
ste_cfg_channel_hint: Only channels visible to @everyone are listed.
ste_button_required: The button needs a text and a link.
ste_alt_text_hint: Describe the image for screen readers and search engines.
ste_assets_subtitle: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 8 MB. Converted to WebP on upload.
ste_assets_empty_desc: Uploaded images can be reused across the site.
ste_err_slug_long: Address too long (40 characters at most).
ste_err_slug_invalid: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
ste_err_site_exists: This server already has a site.
ste_err_site_suspended: This site is suspended by the Kotbo team.
ste_err_invalid_image: This image doesn't come from the site's images.
ste_err_invalid_navigation: The menu contains an invalid link.
ste_err_parent_cycle: A page can't be placed under one of its own subpages.
ste_err_invalid_date: Pick a date in the future.
ste_err_css_too_long: The custom CSS is too long.
ste_err_too_many_pages: Limit of 2,000 pages per section reached.
ste_err_too_large: File too large (8 MB at most).
ste_err_unsupported: Format not accepted. Use PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
ste_err_quota: The site's storage is full (500 MB). Delete unused images.
ste_err_forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
ste_err_agent_locked: An MCP agent is editing the site. Wait for it to finish or interrupt it.
ste_admin_desc: Incoming reports, site lookup, suspension with a reason. Every decision goes to the audit log.
ste_admin_suspend_desc: The site will show an unavailable page. The reason is visible to the server's staff in their dashboard.
ste_mode_hint: Visitors can switch from the site bar.
ste_item_banner_desc: Heading, text and button on a bold background.
ste_banner_text: One sentence that makes people want to join the server.
ste_item_gallery_desc: Images in a grid or a carousel.
ste_item_testimonials_desc: Member reviews, with name and photo.
ste_block_keyStats_desc: A row of server figures, computed live.
ste_cfg_banner_image_hint: Darkened so the text stays readable.
